While EnerSys offers a number of customer-facing web tools (Battery Sizing Program, Motive Power configurator, CARB Compliance Calculator) and product-level telemetry such as the Wi-iQ battery monitoring system and NexSys iON connected fleet platform, no public developer APIs or open specifications have been published as of this index.

providers.name: Epsor
providers.description: Epsor is a French fintech, founded in 2017, that manages employee savings and retirement plans (épargne salariale et retraite) for companies and helps them turn that benefit into an HR lever. A certified B Corp and mission-driven company, Epsor ranks among the top 10 employee-savings and retirement providers in France and serves more than 2,500 corporate clients. It targets HR, Compensation & Benefits, and Finance teams at mid-size and large French firms, combining a pedagogical, personalized saver experience, an open-architecture fund range (40+ funds from 15+ asset managers, with a strong ESG/SRI focus), and year-round support to run and promote the plan. Epsor is neither an asset manager nor a bank: it is the single point of contact for companies and their employees, and delegates account-keeping to Société Générale Securities Services (SGSS). Products span PEE, PER Collectif (PERECO), PER Obligatoire, intéressement, participation, abondement, and employee share ownership. Epsor exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Heirloom
providers.description: Heirloom Carbon Technologies, Inc. is a San Francisco Bay Area direct air capture (DAC) company that removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere by accelerating the natural mineralization of limestone. Heirloom spreads calcium oxide on vertical trays where it re-absorbs atmospheric CO2 in days rather than years, then uses electric kilns to release the captured CO2 for permanent geologic or in-concrete storage. The company opened the first commercial DAC facility in the United States, sells permanent carbon removal credits to individuals, businesses and enterprises, and has signed offtake agreements with Microsoft, Frontier, United's Sustainable Flight Fund and CarbonCure. It is an industrial climate-technology company; it does not operate a public developer program or API.

providers.name: Lightship
providers.description: Lightship is an American manufacturer of all-electric travel trailers, co-founded by former Tesla leaders Toby Kraus and Ben Parker, with design and manufacturing in Colorado and offices in San Francisco. Its flagship product, the AE.1, is marketed as the first mass-produced all-electric travel trailer, offering up to 77 kWh of battery capacity, 1.8 kW of integrated solar, and named technologies including TrekDrive self-propulsion, CampQuiet silent operation, and Aero-Electric Design. Owners control the trailer through an onboard Atlas tablet and companion mobile app. Lightship sells direct to consumer and states that more than 85% of its supply chain is in the United States. Enrichment probes on 2026-07-19 found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; this is a company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API listing.

providers.name: Naturstrom
providers.description: Naturstrom AG is a German energy provider that supplies 100 % renewable electricity, green gas, heating solutions and e‑mobility services to residential and business customers. The company emphasizes sustainability, offers transparent tariffs, and operates under the corporate headquarters in Düsseldorf. It provides customer portals for account management and publishes information about its services, pricing, terms, and privacy policies on its public website.

providers.name: Root Global
providers.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Emidat
providers.description: Emidat GmbH is a Munich-based climate technology company building product intelligence infrastructure for the construction industry. Its SaaS platform lets construction material manufacturers create verified Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), run Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), and produce Digital Product Passports (DPPs) at scale. Emidat ingests plant, ERP, and energy-management data through integrations, performs intelligent data matching, and generates ISO-compliant, verified EPDs in as little as a day rather than the typical six to twelve months. The platform also surfaces environmental-impact hotspots so manufacturers can find emission-reduction opportunities and turn sustainability data into business value. Related tools include the public EPD Database and Emidat Atlas.

providers.name: Jaipur Robotics
providers.description: Jaipur Robotics is a Manno, Switzerland based deep-tech company building advanced computer vision and deep learning solutions for the waste-to-energy sector. Its product, Jaipur Intelligence, applies patent-pending image recognition to plant bunkers and truck unloading bays to detect oversized and dangerous items, map the calorific value (LHV) of incoming waste in real time, and track crane operations — helping operators cut emissions, improve waste mixing and combustion stability, and minimize unplanned shutdowns. The company operates a gated customer application at app.jaipurrobotics.com and is backed by Techstars, Innosuisse, Venture Kick, CSEM and others. It currently publishes a marketing site and a customer login only; there is no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Republic Services
providers.description: Republic Services is one of the largest providers of non-hazardous solid waste disposal, recycling, and environmental services in the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Republic Services serves millions of customers across residential, commercial, industrial, and environmental segments. The company offers waste collection, recycling processing, composting, landfill operations, and digital customer tools for account management, service scheduling, and environmental reporting.

providers.name: Anker Innovations
providers.description: Anker Innovations is a global consumer-electronics company headquartered in Shenzhen, China, known for its Anker charging and power products, Soundcore audio, eufy smart-home and security devices, Nebula projectors, and Anker SOLIX portable power and solar storage. Through the Anker Open Platform (developer.anker.com) the company exposes a developer surface that lets partners integrate and control Anker devices from their own applications via API and SDK, gated behind an Open Platform login. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and is being enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Braven Environmental
providers.description: Braven Environmental provides turn-key plastic waste management solutions through its Braven Reactor Train™ (BRT™) technology, converting waste plastics into valuable resources while reducing carbon footprints. The company partners with businesses and governments to implement sustainable waste processing facilities, offering a science-backed approach to address global plastic pollution.

providers.name: Cantarellenergy
providers.description: Cantarellenergy is a nascent energy technology firm focused on developing advanced renewable power solutions. The company emerged from the API Evangelist harvest backlog and is being profiled to uncover its API offerings, documentation, and ecosystem. While public information is limited, Cantarellenergy aims to innovate in sustainable energy generation, storage, and distribution, targeting both commercial and residential markets. The profiling effort will track the discovery of its web presence, API specifications, and related developer resources as they become available.

providers.name: Cool Planet
providers.description: CoolPlanet is an enterprise energy-management and decarbonisation software company. Its platform, CoolPlanetOS, centralises real-time energy data across multi-site industrial estates, applies AI-driven anomaly detection and efficiency insights, benchmarks performance across facilities, and automates energy and compliance reporting. CoolPlanet pairs the software with consulting and on-site execution services to help manufacturing, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, commercial real estate, mining and shipping enterprises cut energy costs and carbon emissions. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). No public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Electric Car Scheme
providers.description: The Electric Car Scheme is a UK B Corp providing electric vehicle salary sacrifice as an employee benefit. Employees lease any electric car of their choice with the monthly cost deducted from gross salary before Income Tax and National Insurance, saving 20-50% versus a personal lease, while employers save on Class 1A National Insurance. Packages are all-inclusive (lease, insurance, maintenance, servicing and breakdown) with Complete Protection covering employees who leave partway through a lease term. The company integrates with employer payroll systems via API or SFTP and offers Single Sign-On for employees, plus an included Charge Scheme for charging access.

providers.name: Optivolt Labs
providers.description: Optivolt Labs (operating as Optivolt) is a Burlingame, California solar technology company building intelligent home solar systems with power electronics embedded directly inside each panel. Its patented Balancer device shuffles power from stronger to weaker zones within a panel to keep energy flowing in shaded and non-ideal conditions, delivering up to 50% more annual energy and improved shaded performance versus conventional panels. The product line includes 450W N-type mono half-cut panels, universal battery and inverter compatibility, and a real-time monitoring app for tracking energy and savings. Optivolt is a Techstars-backed hardware company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: bp pulse
providers.description: bp pulse provides public EV charging stations and fleet management solutions across multiple countries. It offers businesses and consumers fast, reliable charging infrastructure, mobile app integration, and tools to monitor and optimize electric vehicle usage. The company leverages over a century of energy expertise to deliver scalable charging networks, supporting sustainability and the transition to electric mobility.

providers.name: Coffeecircle
providers.description: Coffee Circle is a German coffee roaster and retailer focused on sustainable, direct‑trade coffee. They sell whole beans, ground coffee, coffee accessories and subscription plans through an online shop, emphasizing fair trade, environmental impact, and transparency about coffee origins.

providers.name: Scania
providers.description: Scania AB is a leading global manufacturer of heavy trucks, buses, and engines, providing sustainable transport solutions and services. Founded in 1891 in Sweden, Scania designs, manufactures, and sells a full range of trucks and buses, as well as engines for marine and industrial applications. The company focuses on innovation, safety, and environmental responsibility, offering digital services and connectivity solutions for fleet management and logistics. Scania operates worldwide, delivering high-quality vehicles and services to customers across various industries, supporting efficient and eco-friendly transportation.

providers.name: Smol
providers.description: Smol is a UK-based direct-to-consumer home-care brand founded in 2018 by Paula Quazi and Nick Green, delivering concentrated, plant-based, cruelty-free cleaning products — laundry capsules, dishwasher tablets, fabric conditioner, surface sprays and personal-care bars — on a flexible subscription that ships refills through the letterbox. The company positions itself as a sustainability challenger to legacy home-care brands, emphasizing reduced plastic, carbon and chemical load, and became a certified B Corporation in July 2022. Backed by Balderton Capital and GV, Smol operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription business; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer program.

providers.name: Bewtr
providers.description: Bewtr (BE WTR) is a premium sustainable water brand offering still and sparkling bottled water in circular premium glass packaging. The company focuses on local sourcing, high‑quality taste, and environmental stewardship, providing a range of products such as AQTiV FILTER, DUO, ONE, COMBI, and TOWER systems. Their mission emphasizes zero waste and circularity, positioning BE WTR as a leader in sustainable premium water solutions worldwide.

providers.name: Buncha
providers.description: Buncha is a scheduled neighborhood grocery delivery service operating across Minnesota and Michigan. Customers shop online from local partner retailers and receive their orders on set weekly routes, with a single refrigerated van consolidating multiple neighbors' orders into one trip for a $3.45 flat delivery fee. Professional personal shoppers hand-pick items into insulated bags, and the aggregated-route model is positioned to cut delivery CO2 emissions by up to 80% versus on-demand services. Buncha is offered through iOS and Android consumer apps and is backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. It is currently a consumer product with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Cur8
providers.description: CUR8 is a carbon removal intelligence platform based in Oxford, United Kingdom, building the global market for high-quality carbon removals with a mission to remove one billion tonnes of carbon a year. Founded in 2021 by Mark Stevenson, Marta Krupinska and Gabrielle Walker, CUR8 combines financial and scientific expertise to source, evaluate and manage diversified carbon removal portfolios spanning nature restoration, biochar, direct air capture, enhanced weathering, superpollutant abatement and sustainable aviation fuel. Its platform surfaces (Discover for sourcing removal assets, Manage for tracking portfolio performance and risk, Finance for capital provision, and the Carbon Planner for strategy) help enterprises invest in carbon impact with confidence on the path to net zero. Clients include Microsoft, Coca-Cola HBC, Standard Chartered, Arup and UBS. CUR8 is backed by Google Ventures (GV) and Airbus Ventures. No public API, SDK or developer program is advertised as of this profile; access is via the CUR8 dashboard and platform.

providers.name: METYCLE
providers.description: METYCLE is a Cologne, Germany-based digital B2B marketplace and AI-powered trading platform for the international secondary (scrap) metal industry, connecting suppliers and buyers of recycled metals - copper, aluminum, zinc, nickel, lead and magnesium - across borders. Operated by METYCLE GmbH and led by managing directors Rafael Suchan and Sebastian Brenner, the company raised a 14.1M euro Series A round to expand its platform for transparent, sustainable global metal trade and to advance circular-economy sourcing of secondary metals. Its customer platform supports biddable listings, product discovery and trade execution. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record; METYCLE currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Orbio
providers.description: Orbio Earth is a climate-tech company (founded 2021; Dover, Delaware, USA and Cologne, Germany) that turns open satellite data into industrial methane intelligence for the energy sector. Its platform detects, quantifies, and tracks methane emissions from oil-and-gas infrastructure globally at asset level with a roughly 5-day revisit rate, using multispectral imagery (Sentinel-2, Landsat 8/9, EMIT) and machine learning, plus Bayesian uncertainty estimation. Customers — oil-and-gas operators and private-equity firms — use it for super-emitter identification, historical trend and root-cause analysis, and compliance with emerging methane regulation. Platform access is offered via the web application or a sales-gated data API integration; there is no public self-serve developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK. Orbio also publishes the open-source Project Eucalyptus methane-detection pipelines on GitHub for research use.

providers.name: Vital Lyfe
providers.description: Vital Lyfe is a Torrance, California hardware company building portable water purification technology designed to scale where infrastructure cannot reach. Its flagship product, Access, is a portable watermaker that converts naturally occurring water, including saltwater, into clean drinking water through a simple place-a-hose, press-start, hydrate workflow. The company sells the Access device and branded gear through a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront and publishes a mission, team, careers, and journal. It was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Vital Lyfe is a consumer-hardware and e-commerce brand with no public API, SDK, or developer program surface.

providers.name: Clingsystems
providers.description: Clingsystems (Cling Systems AB) brokers surplus and end‑of‑life batteries, helping owners sell them to buyers while handling compliance, waste classification and cross‑border shipping. Their mission is to accelerate circular battery value chains, offering a marketplace, inventory visibility and transparent pricing to unlock value that would otherwise be lost.

providers.name: Fronius
providers.description: Fronius International is a global corporation founded in 1945, specializing in welding technology, photovoltaics, battery charging solutions, and energy management systems. With over 6,500 employees across 37 subsidiaries, Fronius delivers innovative, reliable products for solar energy, electric mobility, and industrial welding, emphasizing sustainability and quality. The company connects people, materials, and energy to build a safe, sustainable world.

providers.name: Packhelp
providers.description: Packhelp is a European custom and wholesale packaging platform that lets businesses design, order, and warehouse branded packaging — boxes, mailers, bags, tubes, and accessories — through online design tools and a curated catalog of EU-based producers. Packhelp also markets "the first-ever API for packaging," a sales-gated set of web services that let 3PL, fulfillment, marketplace, logistics, and food-delivery platforms embed packaging quoting, ordering, and a drag-and-drop packaging editor directly into their own applications and whitelabel storefronts.

providers.name: Dyrt
providers.description: Dyrt provides waste‑savings solutions for enterprises, governments and operators, ingesting invoices, contracts, utility bills and hauler data to identify cost reductions, lower emissions and improve vendor management. Their platform offers analytics, automated waste‑diversion tracking and reporting, helping customers such as hotels, arenas and corporate campuses cut waste spend by up to 30%.

providers.name: Eastman Chemical
providers.description: Driven by more than 100 years of continuous innovation, Eastman is a global Fortune 500 specialty materials company that produces a broad range of advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers used in everyday products. Eastman operates a customer-facing Customer Center for orders, documents, and Safety Data Sheets, but no public developer portal or REST API has been documented.

providers.name: Prometheus Fuels
providers.description: Prometheus Fuels is a Santa Cruz, California energy company founded in 2019 by Rob McGinnis and launched out of Y Combinator, producing carbon-neutral electrofuels from atmospheric CO2. Its "no-desorb" direct air capture system dissolves CO2 into carbonate ions in water, and its Faraday Reactor hydrocarbon electrolyzer converts that carbon into methanol, gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and renewable natural gas at room temperature and atmospheric pressure using off-grid solar power. The company also markets an Ultra Long Duration Energy Storage (ULDES) product aimed at data-center power, and operates the Titan Forge Alpha pilot plant in Santa Cruz. It is backed by BMW i Ventures, Maersk Growth and Y Combinator. Prometheus Fuels publishes no product API, developer portal or SDK — it is a physical fuels manufacturer. The single machine-readable surface it operates is the WordPress REST API (wp/v2) behind its corporate site at prometheusfuels.ai, which serves anonymous read access to pages, posts, the site's `news-articles` custom post type, categories, tags, media, comments, users, search, taxonomies, types and statuses, with write operations gated behind WordPress application passwords. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from that live surface.

providers.name: Astronergy
providers.description: Astronergy (Chint New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.) is the photovoltaic cell and module manufacturing arm of China's CHINT Group. Founded in 2006, it is one of the earliest private Chinese enterprises in the PV sector and is ranked among the world's largest module suppliers. It designs, manufactures and sells high-efficiency crystalline-silicon PV cells and modules — notably the n-type TOPCon ASTRO N series in bifacial and monofacial form — for utility-scale power stations, commercial and industrial rooftops, and residential systems. Astronergy sells into more than 140 countries and regions and operates manufacturing bases and sales centers in markets including Germany, Spain, the USA, Brazil and Turkey. Its public web surface is a marketing and product-download site: datasheets, installation manuals, warranty and certification PDFs, a module-authenticity checker and a PV Planner yield calculator. It publishes no developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Audion
providers.description: Audion Packaging Machines, founded in 1947, designs and manufactures innovative packaging solutions for healthcare, food, industry and e‑commerce sectors. Their product range includes automatic baggers, industrial bag sealers and sustainable packaging technologies, emphasizing automation, digital integration and net‑zero operations. Audion serves a global customer base with a focus on quality, reliability and environmental responsibility.

providers.name: Hometree
providers.description: Hometree is a UK home services and residential energy company offering homeowners and landlords subscription-based boiler and home emergency cover with unlimited repairs and annual maintenance from around £12.95 per month. Its nationwide network of Gas Safe registered engineers handles breakdowns across heating, plumbing, electrics, drainage and gas fires, and the company also arranges boiler installations and green home upgrades such as heat pumps and solar panels. Operating as an insurance distributor and installer across mainland England, Scotland and Wales, Hometree is backed by Anthemis, DN Capital, Barclays, BlackRock, 2150 and Puma Growth Partners.

providers.name: Sphera
providers.description: Sphera is a leading provider of integrated sustainability, safety, and risk management solutions. The company offers software, data, and consulting services focused on Environment, Health, Safety & Sustainability (EHS&S), Process Safety, and Product Stewardship. Its platform unifies risk, safety, and sustainability insights to help enterprises turn uncertainty into opportunity, supporting regulatory compliance, operational risk management, and sustainability reporting across multiple industries.

providers.name: Avaada
providers.description: Avaada is India’s largest clean energy conglomerate, integrating solar, wind, hydro, and battery energy storage solutions. The company provides affordable, round‑the‑clock power to accelerate India’s energy transition, offering renewable energy generation, green fuels, data center power, and sustainability services across a global footprint.

providers.name: Constellation Energy
providers.description: Constellation Energy Corporation is a Fortune 500 clean-energy producer and competitive retail electricity and natural gas supplier in the United States, generating power from a fleet of nuclear, hydro, wind, and solar facilities. Constellation does not publish a public developer portal; programmatic interactions are delivered to enterprise and large commercial customers through the Energy Manager platform (account-managed onboarding, no public API specifications) and consumer interactions are handled through the My Constellation account portal. EDI 867 (usage) and 810 (invoice) remain the most common machine-to-machine integration paths and are arranged on a contract-by-contract basis.

providers.name: MoveYou
providers.description: Our scaled based platform meets all your business requirements in the fields of mobility and energy. Explore the powerful solutions or consult one of our experts for advice. Together, we are building a sustainable future for your organization.

providers.name: Naturvårdsverket
providers.description: Naturvårdsverket is Sweden’s Environmental Protection Agency, working to promote a sustainable environment, climate transition, circular economy and biodiversity. It provides guidance, grants, data and statistics, and supports stakeholders through policies, regulations and tools aimed at improving environmental quality across the nation.

providers.name: Shepherd
providers.description: Shepherd provides construction and renewable energy insurance solutions, leveraging data and technology to offer smarter underwriting and financial services for builders and operators. Backed by Costanoa Ventures, the company focuses on risk management, casualty, excess casualty, and builder’s risk products, serving the construction and renewable energy sectors with innovative insurance offerings.

providers.name: Bluwaveai
providers.description: BluWave-ai, founded in Ottawa, Canada in 2017, provides artificial intelligence SaaS platforms that help utilities, data centers, independent power producers, enterprises and fleet operators optimize renewable energy, storage and electric transportation assets, accelerating the global energy transition and reducing emissions.

providers.name: Geocento Limited
providers.description: Geocento Limited provides end‑to‑end virtual constellation design, procurement and management services for earth observation data. Leveraging extensive consulting expertise, they help organisations build and operate custom satellite imaging constellations, offering consultancy, technology platforms, and full‑service procurement to enhance sovereign capabilities and programmatic resilience.

providers.name: Gridware
providers.description: Gridware builds grid intelligence technology for electric utilities. Its Active Grid Response (AGR) platform pairs pole-mounted GridScope sensors with analytics to bring real-time visibility into the physical, electrical, and environmental condition of every span of the distribution grid, closing the "Hazard Awareness Delay" between when a fault or hazard occurs and when a utility detects it. Gridware supports fault prevention, faster power restoration, wildfire and hazard response, and grid asset management. Headquartered in San Francisco with an Applied Research Complex in Richmond, California, the company is backed by True Ventures. Gridware does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity, trust/compliance posture, and domain security.

providers.name: Quaise Energy
providers.description: Quaise Energy is a deep-geothermal energy company and MIT spinout, founded in 2018 by Carlos Araque and Matthew Houde out of a decade of millimeter-wave research by Paul Woskov at the MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center. Quaise is developing millimeter-wave (MMW) drilling — using a gyrotron to vaporize rather than grind rock — to reach supercritical conditions several kilometers down, where temperatures approach 500 degrees C, and to convert existing fossil-fuel power stations to superhot geothermal baseload. The company drilled 100 meters with the technique at its Central Texas field site in 2025. Quaise is an energy and hardware company: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract. Its only public web application is a levelized-cost-of-energy (LCOE) calculator whose full functionality sits behind an AWS Cognito login.

providers.name: SkySpecs
providers.description: SkySpecs is a renewable energy asset management company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan that combines autonomous drone inspections, condition-monitoring hardware, and its cloud-based Horizon software platform to help wind and solar operators manage the health and performance of their assets. Horizon consolidates blade inspection imagery, drivetrain and sensor data, SCADA-based performance analytics, repair-vendor coordination, and financial reporting into one hub, with third-party data ingestion and custom integrations for fleet owners. The company reports assets under contract across six countries and is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management. SkySpecs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve developer portal today; integrations are arranged directly with the Horizon team.

providers.name: SXD
providers.description: SXD is a New York-based design-technology company founded in 2022 that uses patented artificial intelligence to generate zero-waste apparel patterns for the fashion industry. Its SXD AI platform transforms a sketch or design concept into production-ready patterns that eliminate fabric waste before the first cut, and the company reports up to 69% material savings across more than 35 brand and manufacturing partners. SXD has been recognized with the Global Change Award and a top prize at the SXSW Pitch competition, and is backed by Initialized Capital. SXD does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Molnlycke Health Care
providers.description: Molnlycke Health Care is a world‑leading MedTech company based in Sweden, providing innovative wound‑care and surgical solutions. It focuses on improving patient outcomes and supporting healthcare professionals with high‑quality products, sustainability initiatives, and extensive clinical expertise. The company’s corporate site offers information on its portfolio, sustainability, careers, and investor relations, reflecting its commitment to advancing healthcare worldwide.

providers.name: Normative
providers.description: Normative is a Stockholm, Sweden-based carbon accounting and ESG reporting software company helping enterprises measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions across scopes 1, 2, and 3. Its platform combines a library of more than 349,000 region- and sector-specific emission factors with workflows for product carbon footprint (PCF), supply chain engagement, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target setting, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) disclosure, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reporting. Calculations are built to the GHG Protocol and independently verified by TÜV SÜD against ISO/IEC 25051. Customers include Vodafone, Hertz, Hitachi Rail, and Flying Tiger Copenhagen, and every account is paired with a named, GHG Protocol-certified Climate Strategy Advisor rather than a traditional support helpdesk. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscriptions plus advisory services; Normative does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and its GitHub organization (normative-io) currently exposes no public repositories.

providers.name: RMI Belgium WOW-BE
providers.description: The Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium (KMI) provides weather forecasts, climate data, and meteorological services for Belgium. It operates as a public scientific institute, offering open data on observations, forecasts, climate change analyses, and specialized services for government, businesses, and the public. The institute also publishes data portals and documentation for developers to access weather APIs and datasets.

providers.name: Coremins
providers.description: Coremins is a provider of water and wastewater infrastructure solutions, offering a broad portfolio that includes pipe, valves, fittings, fire protection, HDPE fusible piping, metering, storm drainage, geosynthetics, and treatment plant equipment. The company serves utilities and industrial customers across the United States, delivering products and services that support reliable water supply, efficient waste management, and resilient infrastructure. Coremins emphasizes sustainability, innovation, and comprehensive support throughout project lifecycles.

providers.name: Apeel
providers.description: Apeel (Apeel Sciences) is a food technology company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Goleta, California. It produces a plant-derived, edible coating, made from lipids and glycerolipids found in the peels, seeds and pulp of produce, that is applied to fresh fruit and vegetables at packing houses to slow water loss and oxidation, extending shelf life and reducing food waste across the supply chain. Apeel-treated produce is sold through grocery retailers in multiple countries. In 2021 Apeel acquired ImpactVision and added hyperspectral imaging to its supplier installations to grade interior quality, ripeness and freshness. Apeel is a materials-science and supply-chain operator: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, or self-serve developer sign-up.

providers.name: Commons
providers.description: Commons is an Oakland, California consumer climate-fintech company founded in 2018 by Sanchali Seth Pal and operated under the name Joro until its March 2023 rebrand. Its free iOS and Android app connects a user's bank accounts and credit cards through Plaid and runs every transaction through a proprietary carbon-estimation engine, the Carbonizer, which translates dollars spent into an estimate of kilograms of CO2e, alongside budgeting, savings goals, expert-reviewed sustainable brand ratings, a rewards program, monthly community challenges and an optional paid offset membership. The company has raised roughly USD 13.9 million across three rounds from investors including Sequoia Capital and Amasia. Commons is a direct-to-consumer mobile product rather than an API vendor: thecommons.earth is a Webflow marketing site with no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract, its brand directory and member exchange run on Next.js and Softr respectively, and its only public GitHub organization, CommonsTech, holds a single 2023 repository publishing carbon-offset provider evaluations rather than code.

providers.name: Controlled Thermal Resources
providers.description: Controlled Thermal Resources develops the Hell’s Kitchen project, an integrated geothermal power plant that generates renewable baseload electricity and extracts critical minerals such as lithium carbonate, zinc, manganese and potash. The company refines these minerals on‑site into battery‑grade products and supplies clean energy to advanced manufacturers, data centers and battery producers. Its vertically integrated model aims to reduce U.S. supply‑chain risk and support domestic energy and mineral needs.

providers.name: Dominion Dynamics
providers.description: Dominion Dynamics provides advanced energy management and automation solutions for industrial and commercial facilities. Leveraging real-time data analytics, IoT sensors, and AI-driven optimization, the platform helps clients reduce energy consumption, improve operational efficiency, and achieve sustainability goals. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, the company focuses on delivering scalable, cloud-native services that integrate with existing building management systems and support predictive maintenance.

providers.name: Genomatica
providers.description: Genomatica (which markets itself as Geno) is a San Diego, California biotechnology and sustainable materials company founded in 1998 that engineers microbes and fermentation processes to make widely used chemical building blocks from plants instead of fossil fuels. Its commercialized process technology covers Geno BDO (bio-based 1,4-butanediol, licensed to partners including BASF and Novamont), Brontide butylene glycol for personal care, Avela (R)-1,3-butanediol, plant-based nylon-6 intermediates developed with lululemon and manufacturing partners such as Hyosung and Sojitz, plus palm-oil alternatives and fragrance building blocks. Genomatica licenses its process technology to chemical producers rather than operating a software platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, or agent-facing discovery surface.

providers.name: Checkerspot
providers.description: Checkerspot is an Alameda, California biotechnology company, founded in 2016 and incorporated as a Public Benefit Corporation, that designs and produces functional fats and oils through precision fermentation of microalgae. Its biology-driven molecule licensing platform pairs algal strain development, an advanced analytical platform, bioinformatics, high-throughput screening, fermentation scale-up and downstream oil refining, built around the proprietary microbe Prototheca moriformis, which the company reports reaches over 80% oil content by dry cell weight. The commercial molecule portfolio includes a high sn-2 palmitate algal oil that mimics the triglyceride structure of human milk fat for infant nutrition, an Omega-7 (palmitoleic acid) algal oil, a designer high-oleic tropical-fat alternative to palm oil, and Algolein tG C18/80 for cosmetic formulation; earlier work commercialized algae-derived urethane composites through the WNDR Alpine outdoor brand. Checkerspot works through ingredient and manufacturing partners including AAK, Huvepharma and La Fabrique Vegetale, and closed a USD 55 million Series C led by ArrowMark Partners with participation from Cox Enterprises. It is a business-to-business ingredient and molecule licensing company rather than a software vendor: it operates a WordPress marketing site, publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and has no GitHub organization.

providers.name: GeoConnections - Natural Resources Canada
providers.description: GeoConnections - Natural Resources Canada is a government entity focused on ensuring Canada’s abundant natural resources are developed sustainably, competitively and inclusively. It provides geospatial data and services to support environmental stewardship, resource management, and economic development across the country.

providers.name: SESAMm
providers.description: SESAMm provides AI‑powered ESG and reputational risk intelligence, monitoring controversies and exposure across over 5 million public and private companies. Leveraging more than 30 billion documents, its platform helps organizations assess ESG risks, track reputational issues, and make data‑driven decisions.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Apiday
providers.description: Apiday is an ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) software platform built for private markets. It combines AI-powered automation with expert guidance so investors, fund managers, and portfolio companies can streamline sustainability reporting, comply with regulatory frameworks (SFDR, EU Taxonomy, EDCI, PRI, ILPA), automate ESG questionnaires and due-diligence requests, calculate GHG emissions against 3,000+ benchmarks, and turn ESG obligations into measurable value creation. The company reports that over 500 investors and 5,000 companies use the platform across private equity, venture capital, private credit, institutional LP, and infrastructure asset classes. Backed by Speedinvest. Apiday does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Breaker
providers.description: Breaker Industries provides advanced energy management solutions for industrial facilities, enabling real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and optimization of power usage across complex operations. Their platform integrates IoT sensors, AI-driven analytics, and a robust API suite that allows customers to retrieve device data, control equipment, and automate workflows. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Breaker aims to reduce energy costs and carbon footprints while improving operational efficiency for manufacturers, data centers, and large-scale infrastructure.

providers.name: General Fusion
providers.description: General Fusion is a Canadian fusion energy company founded in 2002 by physicist Dr. Michel Laberge and headquartered in Richmond, British Columbia, in the Vancouver area. It is developing Magnetized Target Fusion (MTF), an approach that combines plasma formation, mechanical compression by a liquid metal liner, and practical heat capture for electricity generation. The company operates LM26, which it describes as the world's largest and most powerful operational fusion plasma injector, and reports 24 plasma prototypes, more than 200,000 plasma experiments, 35+ peer-reviewed papers, and roughly 210 issued and pending patents. In July 2026 General Fusion completed a business combination with Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. III and became the first publicly listed fusion energy company, trading on Nasdaq under the ticker GFUZ. It is an energy hardware and research company rather than a software or API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contracts. Its only machine-readable public surfaces are a Yoast-generated llms.txt and the WordPress REST discovery index behind its marketing site.

providers.name: Husk Power Systems
providers.description: Husk Power Systems is an energy technology company, founded in 2008 and headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado with operating hubs in Patna, Mumbai and Pune (India) and Abuja (Nigeria), that builds, owns and operates AI-enabled distributed renewable energy systems — community solar minigrids, commercial and industrial solar, and residential rooftop — for unserved and underserved communities, businesses and households across Africa and Asia. Husk operates one of the largest minigrid fleets in the world and pairs it with pay-as-you-go smart metering, a customer mobile app (HUSKify) and an internal operations platform (Husk Neuron). Its software is delivered as end-user and operator products; Husk publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Nth Cycle
providers.description: Nth Cycle is a critical mineral refining company headquartered in Beverly, Massachusetts, that recovers production-grade nickel, cobalt, copper and rare earth elements from mined ore, low-grade tailings and recycled industrial scrap. Its patented OYSTER platform uses electro-extraction — an alternative to conventional hydrometallurgy and pyrometallurgy that combines electrochemistry, filtration and chemical precipitation into a single continuous, closed-loop architecture — to deliver modular refining at roughly 70% lower capital intensity, 75% less waste, and economic viability at 5-10x smaller scale than a centralized refinery. Systems install inside existing buildings and can be deployed in as little as two years including permitting, under licensing, build-own-operate tolling, or multi-feedstock off-take models. The company operates the first domestic commercial-scale nickel and cobalt scrap refining system in Fairfield, Ohio, holds a $1.1 billion offtake agreement with Trafigura, was selected by the U.S. Department of Energy for award negotiations of up to $100 million toward a new critical mineral refining facility, and has announced a NYSE listing via business combination with Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI. Enrichment probing on 2026-08-26 found no public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger/GraphQL/AsyncAPI contract, developer portal, SDK or package-registry entry, CLI, MCP server, A2A agent card, gRPC/Protobuf or WSDL contract, webhook surface, or served /.well-known document — Nth Cycle is a materials refining company, not an API provider.

providers.name: Omnidian
providers.description: Omnidian, Inc. is a Seattle-based clean energy performance assurance company, founded in 2015, that protects and accelerates investments in residential and commercial solar and battery storage. Its proprietary, machine-learning driven software platform continuously monitors distributed solar assets, diagnoses hardware, communication and environmental faults such as soiling, shading and snow, dispatches a nationwide field service technician network across 48 states, Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico, and underwrites a 95% energy production guarantee that reimburses owners for covered shortfalls. Omnidian serves installers, EPCs, developers, IPPs, solar financing providers, commercial real estate owners and asset investors, and is a Certified B Corporation and a member of the SunSpec Alliance. Its monitoring platform, client portal and field service partner portal are operated as private, authenticated systems; Omnidian publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: PlanetiQ
providers.description: PlanetiQ is a commercial space-weather and atmospheric data company headquartered in Golden, Colorado, operating the GNOMES constellation of small satellites carrying its Pyxis GNSS radio occultation (GNSS-RO) sensor. Pyxis receives signals from all four global navigation constellations (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou) and turns the refracted signal into vertical atmospheric profiles of temperature, pressure, density, refractivity and humidity at 100 m vertical resolution, plus ionospheric total electron content, scintillation phase and polarimetric precipitation observations. The data is sold as Level 1B calibrated phase/SNR and Level 2 bending angle/refractivity products, primarily under U.S. government contracts (NOAA Commercial Data Program radio occultation data buys, NASA Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition, U.S. Air Force STRATFI) and redistributed to authorized users in netCDF via NASA's Satellite Data Explorer. PlanetiQ publishes no public developer program, no API, and no machine-readable API contract; commercial and defense access runs through a sales conversation rather than self-service onboarding.

providers.name: ThredUp
providers.description: ThredUp (NASDAQ: TDUP) is one of the world's largest online resale and consignment platforms for secondhand women's and kids' clothing, shoes, and accessories. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Oakland, CA, it lets consumers buy and sell pre-owned fashion via mailed Clean Out Kits, and powers branded recommerce for 60+ retailers through its Resale-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform. ThredUp does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI; RaaS integrations are arranged through its partner sales team, so this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web, engineering, and policy surface rather than a documented API program.

providers.name: Condor Energy
providers.description: Condor Energy is an AI-powered energy management operating system for enterprise energy procurement, built for industrial companies, retailers, and data center operators who buy electricity at scale. The platform aggregates consumption data, PPAs, solar, batteries, and live market data into real-time dashboards; models load against market dynamics to execute hedging strategies and produce board-ready price-risk reporting; and analyzes granular load data to find flexibility opportunities and evaluate ROI on solar, battery, EV-charging, and hybrid investments. Founded in 2026 by former electricity traders and energy physicists, the Paris-based company is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is published as of this profile.

providers.name: MeteoLux
providers.description: MeteoLux provides comprehensive weather forecasting, climate monitoring, and meteorological data services for Luxembourg and the broader European region. Operating from Luxembourg, the company offers real-time observations, forecasts, aviation weather, and climate analyses through its online platform, serving both public and private sector needs.

providers.name: Commercial Metals Company
providers.description: Commercial Metals Company (CMC) is a Fortune 500 manufacturer, recycler, fabricator and marketer of steel and metal products — rebar, merchant and structural bar, wire rod, performance steel, construction products and ground improvement solutions — running recycling centers, mini-mills, micro-mills and fabrication plants across the United States, Europe and Asia for the construction, infrastructure, energy and manufacturing markets. CMC was an early mover on customer self-service with myCMC, a portal for inventory, pricing, online ordering, material release, document search and real-time order and delivery status, and it runs a business-to-business Systems Integration program whose own one-pager names EDI, API, CSV, XML and flat file across the Quote-To-Cash process. None of it is self-service: no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract is published on any CMC host as of September 2026 — integration is arranged through a CMC sales rep or ecommerce@cmc.com.

providers.name: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms, with approximately 370,000 staff across a global network of member firms coordinated by PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL). PwC organizes delivery across three primary service lines — Assurance (audit), Tax (tax compliance, planning, and reporting), and Advisory (consulting, deals, and risk). The firm operates proprietary technology platforms including PwC Halo (a suite of data analytics tools used to support audit engagements), the Trusted AI initiative (PwC's responsible-AI governance and assurance framework), and ProEdge (a workforce upskilling platform). In April 2024 PwC announced a multi-year alliance with OpenAI positioning the firm as both OpenAI's largest customer and its first reseller of ChatGPT Enterprise, supporting PwC's broader generative-AI consulting practice. PwC's research and insights surface — pwc.com/insights, the annual Global CEO Survey, the Global Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey, the Money Tree report, and regional industry outlooks — is the firm's primary public-facing knowledge product. PwC does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, partner API documentation, or a GitHub organization at the corporate level. The github.com/pwc handle is held by an unrelated individual user (Patrick Clearwater). Any technical integrations with PwC platforms are arranged through engagement contracts and the PwC Technology Consulting practice rather than through self-service developer credentials. PwC's content distribution is reader-facing (newsletter subscriptions, the PwC US Newsroom, LinkedIn, YouTube) with no documented public RSS feed endpoint exposing news, press releases, or insights as a syndication contract.

providers.name: SunPower
providers.description: SunPower is a residential solar energy company (Nasdaq: SPWR) that designs, installs, and finances solar systems and battery storage for homeowners. The original SunPower Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in August 2024; its assets were acquired by Complete Solaria in September 2024, which rebranded as SunPower Inc. in April 2025. SunPower maintains the GitHub org github.com/SunPower, hosting open-source solar modeling tools including pvfactors (view-factor model for bifacial PV modeling), PVMismatch (mismatch loss calculations), and SolarUtils. These Python libraries are used by solar energy professionals and researchers for photovoltaic system modeling and simulation.

providers.name: Ball Corporation
providers.description: Ball Corporation is a global supplier of sustainable aluminum packaging for beverage, food, personal care, and household products, as well as aerospace and other technologies and services for commercial and government customers. Ball operates more than 80 manufacturing plants worldwide and is a leader in aluminum can sustainability and recycling.

providers.name: actnano
providers.description: actnano, Inc. is a Massachusetts-based advanced materials company that develops and manufactures PFAS-free protective nanocoatings for electronics. Its flagship Advanced nanoGUARD technology is a gel-state, 100% fluorine-free conformal coating applied to printed circuit board assemblies, connectors, antennas, LEDs and high-heat-generating components, delivering up to IPx8 moisture and condensation protection without trapping heat or degrading signal integrity. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a Munich center of excellence and operations in Mexico and Japan, actnano serves mobility and automotive electronics, consumer electronics, AI and data-center infrastructure, solar, industrial electronics, medical devices and optical anti-fog applications. The company states REACH and RoHS compliance and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and is backed by BMW i Ventures, Porsche Ventures and Emerald Technology Ventures. actnano is a materials manufacturer: it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: AptDeco
providers.description: AptDeco is a full-service online marketplace for buying and selling used, new, and vintage furniture. Founded in 2014 in New York City by Reham Fagiri and Kalam Dennis, the company handles the entire resale transaction end to end: pickup, disassembly and assembly, delivery, payment, scheduling, and logistics are all carried out by its own trained delivery teams. AptDeco serves the New York City metro, New Jersey, Connecticut, Philadelphia, Delaware, and the San Francisco Bay Area, and has expanded to additional US metros with national shipping. Backed by Y Combinator and Initialized Capital. AptDeco does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, support, legal, and developer surfaces for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hippo Harvest
providers.description: Hippo Harvest is a controlled-environment agriculture company based in Pescadero, California, founded in 2019, that grows USDA-certified-organic leafy greens in modular greenhouses run by custom autonomous mobile robots and machine learning. Its closed-loop, direct-to-root watering and nutrient system is published by the company as using 92% less water, 55% less fertilizer and 94% less land than conventional field agriculture, while pricing to compete with field-grown product. Hippo Harvest sells packaged salad greens (spring mix, spinach, 50/50 blend, butter lettuce) into grocery retail rather than selling software: the robotics, computer vision and growing-control stack is internal operating infrastructure, not a product. It raised a $21M Series B led by Standard Investments in February 2024 and a $30M Series C led by Cox Farms in July 2026, and is permitting a 30-acre facility in Hollister, California. No public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind was found on any host the company controls.

providers.name: kWh Analytics
providers.description: kWh Analytics is a Beaverton, Oregon based managing general agent and data-analytics firm that underwrites property and performance insurance for renewable energy assets — solar, wind, and battery storage. Founded in 2012 and acquired by specialist insurer Beazley in 2023, the company operates what it describes as the industry's largest solar performance database, covering roughly 30% of U.S. solar assets across 300,000+ renewable energy assets and $100B+ in loss data. Its HelioStats platform ingests unstructured asset production documents (via AWS S3, Box, Dropbox, email attachment, or API) and applies OCR and machine learning to extract, validate, standardize, benchmark, and enrich operating data for investors, lenders, and asset owners. Commercial products include data-driven Property Insurance, the Solar Revenue Put credit enhancement, the Wind Proxy Hedge, and the SolarScape market intelligence offering. kWh Analytics also publishes the annual Solar Risk Assessment industry report. There is no public developer portal, published API reference, or machine-readable API specification — data delivery and the HelioStats ingest API are arranged through enterprise engagement.

providers.name: Air Protein
providers.description: Air Protein is a Bay Area food-technology company producing a nutrient-dense, meat-alternative protein made from elements found in the air. Its carbon-conversion fermentation process — derived from NASA closed-loop life-support research — combines carbon dioxide, oxygen, nitrogen, water and renewable energy with hydrogenotrophic microbes to grow a protein flour, which it then transforms into whole-food "air meat" products. Founded by CEO Dr. Lisa Dyson, the company aims to decouple protein production from land and animal agriculture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV; it publishes a marketing site but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Battery Smart
providers.description: Battery Smart is India's largest battery-swapping network for electric two- and three-wheelers, founded in 2019 by Pulkit Khurana and Siddharth Sikka and operated from New Delhi by Upgrid Solutions Private Limited and Upgrid Electrilease Private Limited. It runs an asset-light, partner-led model: local businesses — kirana stores, petrol pumps and neighbourhood shops — host swap points where a driver exchanges a depleted lithium-ion pack for a charged one in roughly two minutes and pays per swap instead of buying the battery with the vehicle, which removes the single largest cost from an electric two- or three-wheeler. The network is concentrated in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Jaipur and Lucknow, and the company has raised across eleven rounds including a USD 65 million Series B led by LeapFrog Investments with MUFG Bank, Panasonic, Ecosystem Integrity Fund, Blume Ventures and British International Investment participating, plus a USD 15 million debt round with Mirova in April 2026. Battery Smart's software ships only as end-user Android applications — Battery Smart Driver and Battery Smart Partner — backed by a production API host at api.upgrid.in that self-identifies as the "Battery Smart API". As of this profile the company publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, webhook catalog or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Bloom Energy
providers.description: Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE: BE) is a San Jose, California hardtech company that designs and manufactures solid-oxide fuel cell "Energy Server" platforms which generate electricity on-site from natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen through an electrochemical process rather than combustion. Its modular systems deliver resilient, always-on power for data centers, manufacturing, healthcare, utilities, and critical infrastructure, can be deployed in roughly 90 days, and scale from single units to hundreds of megawatts. Bloom also builds high-temperature solid-oxide electrolyzers for low-cost hydrogen production. The company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a hardtech portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Concentricinc
providers.description: Concentric Inc provides critical infrastructure power and cooling solutions for data centers, industrial facilities, and commercial enterprises. With over 25 years of experience, they deliver power systems, forklift power, environmental safety products, and maintenance services across the United States, supporting mission‑critical operations and sustainability initiatives.

providers.name: Cycle
providers.description: CYCLE (operated by CM Invest B.V., Amsterdam) is a European electric-mobility subscription service that provides e-bikes and cargo bikes to professional delivery riders, couriers, and businesses. Its all-inclusive monthly subscriptions bundle maintenance, on-site repairs, bike swaps, GPS tracking, theft protection, and remote motor control across 100+ cities in Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, Poland, Italy, and the UK. CYCLE was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the provider publishes a consumer/business marketing and operations site but exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Dcbel
providers.description: Dcbel builds private energy grids for homes, offering the Ara system that integrates solar, battery storage, and vehicle-to-home charging. The company aims to provide reliable, flexible, and clean energy solutions, reducing dependence on traditional grids and enabling homeowners to generate, store, and use power independently. Their platform includes hardware, software, and services to manage energy flow, supporting sustainability and resilience.

providers.name: Geltor
providers.description: Geltor is a biodesign company founded in 2015 by Alex Lorestani and Nick Ouzounov that engineers animal-free designer proteins, peptides and polypeptides and manufactures them through precision fermentation. Its Biodesigner AI computational biology platform is used to imagine, screen and optimize novel protein sequences, which are then scaled commercially as ingredients for beauty and personal care, specialty nutrition and medical/life-science applications. The portfolio includes HumaColl 21 (biomimetic human collagen), HumaColl 21 Select (a matrikine peptide complex), Elastapure (biomimetic human elastin), Collume and Caviance (vegan collagens) and PrimaColl, a Type XXI signaling collagen and the first biotech-derived collagen to receive an FDA GRAS "no questions" letter for ingestible use. Geltor sells business-to-business to brand formulators and manufacturers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Gradiant
providers.description: Gradiant is a global water and wastewater infrastructure company founded in 2013 out of MIT and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, that designs, builds and operates end-to-end industrial water systems from intake to discharge. It positions itself as "the Water Layer of the AI Economy", supplying ultrapure water, process water, wastewater recycling, minimal- and zero-liquid-discharge and resource-recovery systems to semiconductor fabs, AI data centers, energy producers and applied industries including pharmaceuticals, mining, food and beverage, refining and chemicals, textiles and renewables. Its proprietary technology portfolio includes Counterflow Reverse Osmosis (CFRO), Semi-Batch Reverse Osmosis (SBRO), Carrier Gas Extraction (CGE), Selective Contaminant Extraction (SCE), Free Radical Oxidation (FRO), Bio Infinity, the ForeverGone PFAS destruction process, the HyperSolved data-center cooling-water platform, the CURE Chemicals specialty-chemicals line and SmartOps AI, a machine-learning platform for optimizing and predicting plant operations. Gradiant raised a Series E at a $2 billion valuation in May 2026. It is an industrial equipment, chemicals and build-own-operate services company: it publishes no public developer portal, no developer API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and SmartOps AI is delivered as a customer-facing operations platform rather than as a public API.

providers.name: Gridwiz
providers.description: Gridwiz Inc. is a South Korean clean-energy software and hardware company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Seoul. It operates one of Korea's largest demand response (DR) aggregation portfolios, gathering electricity that industrial and commercial customers curtail and selling it into the national power market, and it pairs that with energy storage (ESS), renewable energy / RE100 and PPA advisory, and an e-mobility line covering EV charging controllers, CCS communication modems (EVCC/SECC), bidirectional V2G chargers and the Skyblue consumer charging service. Its e-mobility products are built to the international EV charging standards DIN SPEC 70121, ISO 15118 (including 15118-20 AC/DC) and OCPP, and its demand response management system is described as OpenADR-based. Gridwiz sells energy services and certified hardware to utilities, EVSE suppliers and enterprises; it publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: La Vie
providers.description: La Vie Foods is a Paris-based plant-based food company that makes vegan alternatives to pork products, including bacon, smoked lardons, ham, salami sticks, croquettes and meatballs, sold across French and UK retail and foodservice. Its stated mission is to move people from animal to vegetable fat without compromising on taste, citing 88% less CO2, 82% less water and 74% less land use than conventional pork. Its products are stocked by retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Waitrose, Whole Foods Market and Planet Organic, and used by restaurant partners such as Burger King. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of partech. La Vie Foods operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, CLI, packages or programmatic API surface, and exposes no /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile therefore captures the company's real public web, legal, press and domain-security surface rather than developer artifacts.

providers.name: LARQ
providers.description: LARQ is a direct-to-consumer water technology company that designs self-cleaning and filtering drinkware and home water products. Its flagship Bottle PureVis uses UV-C light to neutralize up to 99.9999% of harmful, odor-causing bacteria in the bottle and on the water surface, and the range extends to filtered bottles, filtered pitchers, an under-sink water filter, and the cuva beverage flavor line. The company positions itself around sustainable hydration — reducing single-use plastic bottle consumption — and funds environmental nonprofits from a portion of each purchase. LARQ is a consumer hardware and e-commerce business: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and no /.well-known/ discovery documents. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: MayMaan Research
providers.description: MayMaan Research is a clean-energy engineering company that redesigns the internal combustion engine around its patented AquaStroke platform, a piston engine that runs on a blend of roughly 70% water and 30% bio-alcohol (ethanol or methanol) instead of gasoline or diesel. The company builds modular generator sets and powertrains that scale from a 35 kW unit (A35) through the AV2 to multi-megawatt installations, and it positions them as drop-in replacements for diesel gensets in power generation, EV charging infrastructure, data centers, telecommunications, marine, construction, agriculture, defense and off-grid deployments, with near-zero NOx, SOx, CO2 and particulate output. MayMaan is headquartered in Hollywood, Florida with a European office in Paris, holds engine and fuel-system patents internationally, and raised a $30 million Series A led by WAVE Equity Partners. It is a hardware manufacturer: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Modern Meadow
providers.description: Modern Meadow is a bio-design and materials-science company founded in 2011 in Brooklyn by Andras Forgacs, Francoise Marga, Gabor Forgacs and Karoly Jakab, now headquartered in Nutley / Pine Brook, New Jersey, where it operates an innovation lab opened in 2017. The company applies synthetic biology and protein engineering to build animal-free, bio-fabricated alternatives to leather and other petrochemical-derived materials, through the Bio-Alloy technology platform (an alloy of engineered proteins and bio-based polymers), the BIO-VERA material launched in 2023, and its current flagship INNOVERA, a next-generation leather alternative made from plant proteins, biopolymers and recycled rubber with more than 80% renewable carbon content. It sells into interiors, fashion and accessories, footwear, and automotive, and has partnered with BASF, tannery HELLER-LEDER (a 2026 European joint venture) and Allbirds (the Terralux footwear line). Modern Meadow has raised roughly $236M. It is a materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: profiling on 2026-08-01 found no public API, no developer portal, no documentation, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP surface, no /.well-known/ documents, and no GitHub organization. Its corporate site (modernmeadow.com, Craft CMS) largely redirects to the product site innovera-world.com.

providers.name: Ohmium
providers.description: Ohmium International designs, manufactures and deploys modular, vertically-stackable proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzer systems for cost-competitive green hydrogen production. Its Lotus PEM electrolyzer platform integrates power electronics, water treatment and controls into skid-mounted modules for industrial, energy and mobility customers, and is paired with EPC and remote monitoring and maintenance (RM&M) services. Ohmium is a hardware and clean-energy engineering company: it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its customer-facing monitoring and service portals are third-party SaaS products hosted on Ohmium subdomains behind login.

providers.name: ResourceWise
providers.description: ResourceWise is a market intelligence company for sustainable commodities, delivering data, analytics, pricing benchmarks, forecasts, and consulting across the forest products, pulp and paper, biofuels, and chemicals markets. It was formed by unifying established industry brands including Tecnon OrbiChem, Wood Resources International, Fisher International, Forest2Market, Prima Markets, and Chemical Intelligence under the ResourceWise name. Its subscription platforms include ChemEdge360, FisherSolve, Forestat Global, OrbiChem360, Prima CarbonZero, Recycled Fiber 360, SilvaStat360, and WoodMarket Prices. The company is backed by Battery Ventures. No public API or developer portal is currently published; access is delivered through its SaaS platform logins.

providers.name: SupplyShift
providers.description: Sphera, the brand that includes the former SupplyShift, provides a Supplier Engagement solution that enables organizations to automate outreach, collect and validate supplier information, and integrate the data into risk and sustainability platforms. The software is aimed at buyers and supply chain teams seeking to improve visibility, compliance and risk scoring across their supplier base.

providers.name: AgFunder
providers.description: AgFunder is a global agrifood-tech venture capital firm investing in deeptech and foundational technologies across AI, biology, robotics, and climate to advance food, agriculture, and human and planetary health. Founded roughly a decade ago by Michael Dean and Rob Leclerc and headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices in London and Singapore, the firm manages over $300M in assets and has backed more than 100 portfolio companies across four continents. AgFunder also operates AgFunderNews (AFN), the leading agtech and foodtech news and research publication, and publishes market research for the agrifoodtech ecosystem. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the firm's public identity and site properties; AgFunder publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Alta Resource Technologies
providers.description: Alta Resource Technologies is a Colorado-based deep-tech company reinventing how critical minerals are sourced. It uses advanced biochemistry — customizable, engineered proteins licensed from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and co-developed with researchers at Pennsylvania State University — to selectively separate high-purity rare earth elements and other strategic metals from low-grade ores, mining tailings, and electronic-waste streams such as end-of-life hard disk drives. The protein-based platform binds target elements out of complex, low-concentration solutions with high selectivity while dramatically reducing the environmental footprint of conventional mining and refining, strengthening U.S. and allied critical-mineral supply chains. Alta emerged from stealth in January 2025 and expanded its Series Seed to $10M, backed by DCVC, Voyager Ventures, In-Q-Tel, and Orion Industrial Ventures. As a materials-science and biochemistry company, Alta does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile carries its identity and website properties only.

providers.name: Cake
providers.description: Cake (stylized CAKE) is a Stockholm, Sweden based maker of premium, lightweight, high-performance electric motorcycles and mopeds, built around a mission to accelerate the shift to a zero-emission society by combining excitement with responsibility. Its clean-mobility lineup spans commuter models (Makka, Osa), off-road bikes (Kalk, Bukk) and work-focused utility variants. Founded by Stefan Ytterborn and backed by Creandum, CAKE filed for bankruptcy in early 2024 and its brand and IP were acquired by Norway's Brages Holding AS, which relaunched the company. Cake sells direct to consumers and through dealers at ridecake.com. Its bikes ship with the CAKE Connect module, and CAKE markets a "CAKE API" on its own :work and delivery pages that lets fleet owners pull vehicle data, telemetry and controls into their own fleet software — but that API has no public developer portal, no reference and no machine-readable specification; access runs through the contact and partner forms.

providers.name: Calysta
providers.description: Calysta, Inc. is a cellular agriculture company founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, with operations in Memphis, Tennessee (NouriTech), Wilton/Teesside in the United Kingdom (Calysta UK Ltd.) and Singapore (Calysta Asia Pte Ltd.). It produces protein ingredients through a patented gas-fermentation platform in which a naturally-occurring microorganism converts carbon and energy into a non-GMO single-cell protein, using no arable land and no plant or animal inputs. Its product family includes FeedKind for aquaculture and livestock, FeedKind Pet, FeedKind Net Zero and Positive Protein for human food ingredients; FeedKind Aqua is sold globally through Calysseo, a 50/50 joint venture with Adisseo whose first production plant in China manufactures thousands of tonnes per year. Calysta sells physical protein ingredients to feed and food manufacturers — its fermentation platform is industrial process technology, not commercial software — and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Charm Industrial
providers.description: Charm Industrial is a carbon removal technology company that permanently sequesters atmospheric CO2 by converting waste biomass (agricultural residues and other plant matter) into a stable, carbon-rich liquid called bio-oil through fast pyrolysis, then injecting that bio-oil into EPA-regulated underground wells where it solidifies and remains stored for millennia. Charm sells verified carbon dioxide removal (CDR) credits to enterprise buyers and publishes a public ledger of delivered tonnage. The company received a $53M advance market commitment from Frontier and is backed by investors including General Catalyst and Lowercarbon Capital. This API Evangelist profile tracks Charm Industrial as a company; the provider publishes a marketing and carbon-purchasing website but no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Elevarm
providers.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.

providers.name: Enough
providers.description: ENOUGH (brand name ABUNDA) is a food-technology company that produces mycoprotein through a zero-waste fermentation process, growing fungi on grain-derived sugars. Operating as a B2B ingredient supplier to retailers and food brands, ENOUGH makes nutrient-dense, sustainable meat and seafood alternatives — including burgers, chicken-style products, noodles, and snacks — that use dramatically less water and produce far less CO2 than conventional animal protein. The company operates one of the world's largest mycoprotein fermentation facilities and is backed by DCVC. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; ENOUGH is a food-ingredient business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Epic CleanTec
providers.description: Epic Cleantec is a San Francisco based water technology company that designs, builds and operates onsite water reuse systems for buildings. Its OneWater and OneWater Rain systems collect, treat and recycle a building's greywater, blackwater, rainwater and condensate onsite — recovering up to 95% of wastewater for non-potable uses such as toilet flushing, irrigation, cooling towers and laundry — alongside wastewater heat recovery and a soil amendment product line. The technology grew out of work on the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation Reinvent the Toilet Challenge and is deployed in multifamily, commercial office, hospitality, stadium, data center, higher education and community-scale developments across North America.
