providers.description: Aerospacelab is a vertically integrated satellite manufacturer headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, founded in 2018 by Benoit Deper. The company designs, builds, tests and operates small-to-medium satellites — its Versatile Satellite Platform (VSP-50, VSP-150, VSP-300) family plus mission-specific payloads spanning very-high-resolution and multispectral/hyperspectral Earth observation, synthetic aperture radar, radio-frequency sensing, and narrowband/broadband telecommunications — for commercial, institutional and government customers, with an explicitly ITAR-free European supply chain. It is roughly 90% vertically integrated across platforms, payloads, avionics and subsystems, has flown eight satellites in under three years, acquired Belgian space-optics firm AMOS, and is building a European satellite megafactory targeting 500 satellites per year. Aerospacelab publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; its programmatic surfaces (mission control, tasking, image-processing pipeline and data platform built under the ESA InCubed MultiSpectral Companion Mission) are delivered to contracted mission customers rather than to self-serve developers.

providers.name: Chakrinnovation
providers.description: Chakr Innovation manufactures retrofit emission control devices (RECD) and related clean‑air technologies for diesel generators, including the Chakr Shield, Dual Fuel Kit 2.0, DeNOx, DeSmog dust suppression, and real‑time emission monitoring systems. It also offers aluminium‑air battery energy storage solutions. Its customers are large corporates, industrial facilities, real‑estate developers, institutions and public‑sector organisations across India that need to meet air‑quality regulations.

providers.name: Resynergi
providers.description: Resynergi is an advanced plastic recycling technology company that builds modular Continuous Microwave Assisted Pyrolysis (CMAP) systems, marketed as AMP Modules, which convert hard-to-recycle waste plastics (HDPE, LDPE, polypropylene and polystyrene) into circular pyrolysis oil (PyOil) and other petrochemical feedstocks. Each 440 sq ft module is designed to process roughly 5 tons of plastic waste per day and produce about 1,000 gallons of PyOil per day, and the company claims a conversion roughly twenty times faster than conventional pyrolysis with a large reduction in CO2-equivalent emissions. Founded in 2015 by Jason Tanne and Brian Bauer around microwave pyrolysis research from the University of Minnesota, Resynergi commercializes its modules in partnership with Lummus Technology, which sells the AMP Modules, and also operates plants near the source of waste under a partner model. This is an industrial process-equipment business; it is not a software vendor and publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Verdagy
providers.description: Verdagy is a Moss Landing, California clean-energy hardware company that designs and manufactures dynamic alkaline water electrolysis systems for large-scale green hydrogen production. Its eDynamic platform runs very large-area membrane-based electrochemical cells at high current density with dynamic turndown, so electrolyzers can follow intermittent renewable power, targeting fossil-fuel cost parity for clean hydrogen by 2028 without subsidies. The company operates a 2 MW eDynamic demonstration plant at Moss Landing with more than 21,000 commercial cell hours, plus 500 kW and 100 kW test plants, and opened a DOE-supported gigawatt-scale manufacturing facility of more than 100,000 square feet in Newark, California. Verdagy sells electrolyzer hardware and project capacity to industrial hydrogen buyers — refining, ammonia, methanol, e-fuels and SAF — rather than software; it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Glyph
providers.description: Glyph is a sustainable footwear brand that designs digitally knit, versatile everyday shoes engineered to be worn for every occasion. Backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through its Shopify storefront at glyph.earth, emphasizing low-waste digital knitting, single-shoe versatility, and eco-conscious materials. Glyph is a physical consumer-products (DTC e-commerce) company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its web and policy surface for network completeness.

providers.name: PolyXLabs
providers.description: PolyXLabs is a Techstars-backed biotechnology and sustainable-materials company developing biodegradable plastic alternatives from lignocellulose-based biomass, including food waste such as spent coffee grounds. The company produces customized, toxin-free, microplastic-free polymers designed to be lightweight and durable as drop-in replacements for conventional plastics in consumer goods and packaging, with operations across the United States and Europe and headquarters in Martonvasar, Hungary. PolyXLabs currently publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Understory
providers.description: Understory is an insurtech company headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin (founded 2012) that combines its own network of ground-truth Dot weather sensors with a proprietary weather risk model to underwrite parametric insurance against severe weather, including hail coverage for automotive dealership open lots and agricultural weather risk. Its UnderstoryOS platform covers broker management, pricing and quoting, and automated weather-triggered claims. Understory publishes no public API or developer portal; the platform is offered to insurance partners rather than as a self-service developer product.

providers.name: Visolis
providers.description: Visolis is a biomanufacturing company that combines synthetic biology with chemical catalysis to convert plant biomass into MEV (mevalonic acid), a proprietary platform molecule used to make sustainable, bio-based alternatives to petroleum-derived chemicals and fuels. Its products include bio-isoprene for synthetic rubber (a partnership with Zeon), AroSAF 100% bio-based sustainable aviation fuel, and non-toxic bio-based industrial solvents (piloted with the U.S. Department of Defense). Headquartered in San Leandro, California and led by CEO Deepak Dugar, Visolis is a climate-tech company surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Visolis publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Powerledger
providers.description: Powerledger (Powerledger AG / Power Ledger Pty Ltd, Perth, Western Australia) builds software for tracking, tracing and trading renewable energy and environmental commodities. Its platform is modular and sold to utilities, retailers, network operators, generators and corporates rather than to developers: xGrid and uGrid for peer-to-peer energy trading across and behind the meter, TraceX as a marketplace for Renewable Energy Certificates and other Energy Attribute Certificates (integrated with the M-RETS and ERCOT registries), Vision and PPA Vision for 24/7 renewable portfolio and PPA tracking, plus hydrogen and EV settlement products. Powerledger originally ran its own permissioned Solana-derived chain (the Powerledger Energy Blockchain, source at github.com/PowerLedger/powr) and has since moved to Solana mainnet, where the POWR SPL token lives. As of this profile Powerledger publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Solfacil
providers.description: Solfacil is a Brazilian clean-energy fintech and photovoltaic distributor that operates the largest solar-energy ecosystem in Latin America. Through a B2B2C model it connects more than 20,000 partner solar integrators to 100% digital solar financing (approval in ~30 seconds, terms up to 120 months), distribution of homologated PV equipment (own branches in Jundiai-SP, Jaboatao dos Guararapes-PE and Tubarao-SC), the Solfacil Smart monitoring and asset-management platform, battery/BESS storage, insurance products, and the Solfacil Academy training programs. Financial products are regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil via Solfacil SCFI S.A. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and QED Investors; no public developer API was found - the customer surface is the partner Integrator Portal, storefront, and monitoring platform.

providers.name: Steel Dynamics
providers.description: Steel Dynamics, Inc. is one of the largest domestic steel producers and metals recyclers in the United States, with operations spanning steel manufacturing, steel processing, and metals recycling. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana, the company operates steel mills, fabrication operations, and metals recycling facilities. Steel Dynamics is a Fortune 500 company listed on NASDAQ (STLD) and does not offer public developer APIs; data access is available through financial data providers and investor relations communications.

providers.name: Stegra
providers.description: Stegra (formerly H2 Green Steel) is a Stockholm-headquartered industrial company, founded in 2020 and backed by Vargas Holding, building what it describes as Europe's first large-scale near-zero-emission steel plant in Boden, northern Sweden. The 270-hectare Boden site integrates a giga-scale electrolyzer producing green hydrogen from renewable Nordic electricity, a direct-reduction plant making green iron without coking coal, and a downstream steel mill — a combination Stegra says cuts steelmaking emissions by roughly 95 percent versus the blast-furnace route. Its commercial products are green steel, green iron and green hydrogen, sold to automotive, construction and appliance customers. Stegra is a heavy-industry manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it operates no public developer portal, publishes no API documentation, and serves no machine-readable API contract. Its only public engineering surface is the stegraab GitHub organization, which maintains community Terraform providers and a tflint ruleset used for its own internal infrastructure.

providers.name: Airforestry
providers.description: AirForestry is a Swedish climate-technology company developing autonomous electric drones that perform forest thinning from the air. Its system pairs AI and computer vision for tree identification and selection with a lightweight aerial harvesting tool, letting a fleet of drones fell and extract trees without ground machinery. The result is forestry with zero soil compaction, no root damage and no machine tracks, higher operational efficiency, and lower emissions than conventional harvesters, while increasing forest growth and carbon sequestration. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. It currently publishes a marketing and news presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Equilibrium Energy
providers.description: Equilibrium Energy is a venture-backed clean energy technology company building PowerOS, an agentic AI platform for the power and energy sector. The platform is designed to solve the extreme data and systems fragmentation across the power tech stack, uniting enterprise data, models, and systems under a common ontology and code frameworks so that power companies can deploy power-specific AI with guardrails they control. PowerOS bundles enterprise agents (trader and research copilots, app co-developers, data ingestion and transformation), configurable application suites (portfolio management, portfolio construction, development workbenches, middle and back office), and reusable core services (optimization, forecasting, risk, grid and market fundamentals, trading). The company's Mission Control product is in invite-only beta. Equilibrium Energy is backed by DCVC and is headquartered in the United States. It currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, news, and organization surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Esper Satellite Imagery
providers.description: Esper Satellite Imagery is an Australian space-technology company building an 18-satellite hyperspectral Earth-observation constellation (the Over The Rainbow / OTR program) to deliver global chemical-composition data of the planet's surface from orbit. Its Esperesso hyperspectral imagers capture more than 100 contiguous spectral bands spanning roughly 400 to 1000 nm, which Esper turns into mineralisation maps that identify lithium, rare earths, gold, nickel, cobalt and alteration zones for critical-mineral exploration — faster, cheaper and greener than traditional ground surveys. Founded in 2021 in Melbourne, Victoria by Iqbal and Joey Lorenczak, Esper sells custom area-of-interest mineral maps and a pre-built Northern Territory mineral map. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, security and code-repository surface.

providers.name: Green Software Foundation
providers.description: The Green Software Foundation is a Linux Foundation project founded by Accenture, GitHub, Microsoft, and ThoughtWorks to build standards, tools, and best practices for reducing the carbon emissions of software. It developed the Software Carbon Intensity specification and provides patterns for building green software.

providers.name: National Invasive Species Information Center
providers.description: National Invasive Species Information Center (NISIC) is the gateway to invasive species information covering federal, state, local, and international sources. Invasive species are plants, animals, or pathogens that are non-native to the ecosystem under consideration, and whose introduction causes or is likely to cause harm.

providers.name: National Pesticide Information Center
providers.description: The National Pesticide Information Center (NPIC) provides objective, science-based information about pesticides and their potential health and environmental effects. NPIC is a cooperative agreement between Oregon State University and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, serving the general public, health professionals, and pesticide manufacturers.

providers.name: Terawatt Infrastructure
providers.description: Terawatt Infrastructure is a US infrastructure company that acquires, develops, owns, and operates purpose-built electric-vehicle charging centers for commercial fleets — medium- and heavy-duty trucking, drayage, autonomous vehicle and rideshare operators. The company sells charging-as-a-service rather than software: it holds real estate and grid interconnection, builds high-power charging sites (including the I-10 electrified corridor and sites near the Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach), and runs them with its own proprietary Charge Management Software, operations and maintenance program, and a customer reservations portal. Terawatt states publicly that it has implemented the Open Charge Point Interface (OCPI) with custom extensions so fleet customers get visibility into its charging facilities, but it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract for that surface.

providers.name: EverestLabs
providers.description: EverestLabs builds AI, computer vision, and robotics for the recycling industry. Its RecycleOS platform identifies, tracks, and sorts recoverable materials on the conveyor lines of Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs), giving recyclers, reclaimers, and packaging manufacturers analytics, bale tracing, plant optimization, and compliance reporting to increase recovery rates, cut labor costs, and verify recycled content. Headquartered in Fremont, California and backed by Sierra Ventures. EverestLabs does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, GitHub, and discovery surface.

providers.name: Atomo Coffee
providers.description: Atomo Coffee is a Seattle-based food-tech company that makes beanless "molecular" coffee: it reverse-engineers the coffee bean and reconstructs the taste, aroma, and caffeine of coffee from upcycled, naturally derived plant ingredients, producing cold brew, ground, and canned products with a lower carbon and water footprint than conventional bean-grown coffee. Backed by bessemer-venture-partners and other investors, it sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at atomocoffee.com. Atomo is a consumer packaged-goods brand and publishes no first-party developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. Sector: deep-tech / food-tech.

providers.name: Interface Inc
providers.description: Interface Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Interface Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Newlight Technologies
providers.description: Newlight Technologies, Inc. is a Huntington Beach, California biotechnology company founded in 2003 and incorporated in Delaware that produces AirCarbon, a PHB biomaterial made by naturally-occurring ocean microorganisms that consume air and greenhouse gas. The company operates a commercial-scale biomanufacturing plant and sells AirCarbon as resin to industrial partners and as finished goods under the Restore foodware and Covalent fashion-accessory brands, positioning the material as a carbon-negative, home-compostable, ocean-degradable replacement for petroleum plastic. Newlight is a materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable contract. Its only agent-reachable surface is the Wix platform Site MCP endpoint that its marketing site advertises in its own llms.txt.

providers.name: Polestar
providers.description: Polestar is a Swedish premium electric performance car brand, originally spun out of Volvo Cars' Polestar Performance racing arm and now jointly owned by Volvo Cars and Zhejiang Geely Holding Group. Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden and publicly listed on Nasdaq (ticker PSNY) since 2022, Polestar designs and sells a lineup of battery-electric vehicles — Polestar 1 (discontinued hybrid GT), Polestar 2 (fastback), Polestar 3 (SUV manufactured in South Carolina and Chengdu), Polestar 4 (SUV coupe), and the upcoming Polestar 5 GT. The vehicles run a Google Automotive Services–based infotainment platform with Google built-in (Maps, Assistant, Play Store), and support NACS-compatible DC fast charging in North America. Polestar emphasizes sustainability through the Polestar 0 project (climate-neutral car by 2030) and partnerships with Circulor for battery traceability. Polestar does not currently publish or document a public developer API, SDK, OEM connected-car API, or partner integration programme; all known third-party Polestar integrations (Home Assistant, community Python clients) rely on reverse-engineering the unauthenticated customer app endpoints and are explicitly unsupported by Polestar.

providers.name: Windward
providers.description: Windward is a Maritime AI company headquartered in London and Washington D.C. delivering mission-grade, multi-source maritime intelligence for defense agencies, law enforcement, customs, energy and commodity traders, marine insurers, shippers, and financial institutions. Founded by CEO Ami Daniel, Windward fuses AIS data, remote sensing (EO, SAR, RF GEOINT), proprietary behavioral analytics, and generative AI into a single Maritime AI platform covering vessel screening, ownership and entity resolution, sanctions exposure, deceptive shipping detection, ship-to-ship transfer analysis, IUU fishing detection, smuggling detection, container tracking, and maritime infrastructure protection. Windward exposes its intelligence through the API Insights Lab, a unified GraphQL API at developer.windward.ai providing programmatic access to vessel risk scores, Organization Defined Risk (ODR), ultimate beneficial ownership, early detection signals, tracked shipments, carriers, and detention & demurrage data, along with webhooks and workflow automation. The company has no public REST/OpenAPI surface, no public SDKs, and no public GitHub org — its API is GraphQL-only with managed onboarding and expert-led implementation support.

providers.name: Artin Energy
providers.description: Artin Energy provides solar and renewable energy solutions for businesses, including solar modules, green hydrogen, energy storage, EV charging stations, and hydroponics powered by AI. The company offers engineering, procurement, and construction services, power purchase agreements, and consulting to optimize energy use for commercial clients.

providers.name: feld.energy
providers.description: feld.energy (Feld.Energy GmbH) is a Freising, Germany based Agri-PV (agrivoltaics) project developer and investment company that helps farmers and landowners install turnkey agricultural photovoltaic systems on their fields. It combines expertise from agriculture, energy, and project development to co-locate crop or livestock production with solar generation, offering landowners lease income, revenue sharing, or full-ownership models with state-secured grid feed-in over roughly 20 years. The company handles every step from land assessment and permitting through construction and operation. It reports 800+ partner farmers, 900+ hectares of projects, and 320+ MW of secured grid capacity. It is a portfolio company of HV Capital and is in the API Evangelist network as a climate-energy company profile; it publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Sourceful
providers.description: Sourceful is a Manchester, United Kingdom packaging technology company that began as a sustainable packaging marketplace connecting brands with vetted manufacturers and offering data-driven carbon footprint, life-cycle, and recyclability metrics for every packaging design. Founded in 2020 by Wing Chan and Charlie Bradshaw, the company raised roughly $32M from investors including Index Ventures, Coatue, and Eka Ventures, and grew to over 100 employees serving climate-conscious consumer brands. Since 2024–2025 Sourceful has pivoted toward AI-powered visual design for packaging, releasing Sourceful 3.0 and Riverflow 1, a proprietary image-editing foundation model marketed as state-of-the-art for design-grade, print-ready packaging artwork. The current product line covers AI logo design, packaging design, AI product photography, image editing, packaging ranges, flavor/variant ranges, brand moodboards, and (announced) product mockups and social ads. Sourceful is ISO 42001 certified for AI management. As of this profile the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or open-source GitHub organization for the packaging/design platform, and the original sustainable-packaging marketplace surface and supplier-facing carbon footprint API have been superseded by the AI design product; there is no Sourceful developer portal at this time. The unrelated github.com/sourceful organization belongs to Pony Foo, not this company, and sourceful.energy is a separate distributed-energy-resource platform unrelated to Sourceful Ltd.

providers.name: Diamond Foundry
providers.description: Diamond Foundry is a deep-tech materials company that manufactures semiconductor-grade single-crystal diamond wafers and diamond transistors to overcome the thermal limits of silicon in AI chips, datacenters, and electric vehicles. The company operates its own foundries and has built a full technology stack for producing diamond at scale as a sustainable substrate for high-performance and power electronics. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a planetary-health portfolio company of Obvious Ventures; it publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: INURU
providers.description: INURU (Inuru GmbH) is a Berlin-based printed-electronics company that manufactures ultra-thin, flexible printed OLED lighting for smart packaging, labels, apparel, and medical products. Its core product, the Elf (Embeddable Luminous Film), combines an inkjet-printed OLED, a power source, and a microchip into a paper-thin, waterproof film that can glow in any shape and respond to touch, motion, or sound. Founded in 2016, Inuru operates the automated "Dragon Factory" OLED production line in Wildau and works with brands such as Coca-Cola and Marvel on interactive, sustainable smart-packaging and medication-adherence labels. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Inuru is a hardware and smart-packaging manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: JetZero
providers.description: JetZero is a Long Beach, California aerospace company founded in 2021 by Tom O'Leary and Mark Page to bring the blended wing body (all-wing) airframe to commercial aviation. Its flagship program is the Z4, a 250-seat, international-range jetliner the company says will burn up to 50% less fuel than comparable tube-and-wing airliners, and the Jet1 full-scale demonstrator being built with Scaled Composites in Mojave, California ahead of a first flight targeted for 2027. JetZero broke ground in 2026 on a manufacturing and final-assembly campus in Greensboro, North Carolina and is opening an engineering office in Wichita, Kansas at NIAR. It is backed by the U.S. Air Force, NASA, United Airlines, Alaska Star Ventures and a $175M Series B led by B Capital, with letters of intent from Gulf Air and Japan Airlines. JetZero is an aircraft manufacturer, not a software or data provider: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its public technical surface is a supplier registration and supplier standards program.

providers.name: 6K
providers.description: 6K Inc is a North Andover, Massachusetts advanced-materials company that produces engineered powders and battery materials with UniMelt, its patented microwave-based production-scale plasma system. Named for the roughly 6,000 K plasma temperature it operates at — the temperature of the surface of the sun — UniMelt uses tightly controlled thermal plasma beams to melt or vaporize precursor feedstock into particles with precise size distribution and crystalline phase, in seconds rather than the days conventional processes require, while cutting energy use and eliminating wastewater. The company operates through two divisions. 6K Additive, with production in Burgettstown, Pennsylvania, makes sustainably sourced metal powders for additive manufacturing — titanium Ti-6Al-4V, nickel superalloys Ni625 and Ni718, stainless SS316L, refractory tungsten, niobium C103, copper C18150 and the HEA1000 refractory alloy — reclaiming CNC scrap and revert metal into premium AM powder. 6K Energy produces domestically sourced lithium-ion battery cathode and solid-state materials including NMC, LFP, LLZO, LMO, LTO and LNMO. Additional applications span semiconductor CMP, specialty ceramics, advanced coatings, lighting and display materials, nano-engineered powders, and federal/defense programs; 6K has received US Department of Defense and Department of Energy awards for domestic critical-materials capacity. 6K is a privately held company whose shares trade on secondary markets. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-31 found no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, developer portal, SDK, MCP server, agent card, or event surface — 6K is a materials manufacturer, not an API provider.

providers.name: Candela
providers.description: Candela is a Swedish manufacturer of electric hydrofoiling boats and ferries, on a mission to decarbonize waterborne transportation. Its proprietary computer-controlled hydrofoil system, C-Pod electric propulsion, and C-Foil technology lift the hull clear of the water to cut energy consumption by roughly 80% versus conventional planing hulls, enabling silent, long-range, zero-emission travel. Products span leisure craft (the C-8 and C-7 dayboats) and professional vessels (the P-12 electric ferry and shuttle for public and commercial transport). Backed by EQT Ventures, Candela is a hardware and mobility company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This record captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Claros
providers.description: Claros is a data center power delivery company reimagining how energy moves from chip to grid for AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. Based in Torrance, California with an office in McLean, Virginia, the company builds two hardware-and-software product lines: an Integrated Voltage Regulator (IVR) that targets the roughly 40 percent of chip power lost to heat at the point of delivery, and a Power Gateway that manages broader data center power distribution where 30 to 50 percent of power is lost to transmission, conversion, and cooling. Claros is an early-stage hardware company backed by General Catalyst and Red Cell Partners; its founding team collectively holds 286 patents and has brought more than 80 gigawatts of projects to market. As of 2026 it is pre-product (prototypes in development, engineering samples planned for 2026, low-volume production 2027, high-volume scale 2028) and publishes no developer API, SDK, or public documentation surface yet — this profile captures its public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cubenergy
providers.description: Cubenergy (ShenZhen Cubenergy Co., Ltd. / 库博能源) is a BloombergNEF Tier 1 manufacturer of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for commercial, industrial, and utility-scale deployments. The company integrates self-developed Battery Systems, BMS, and EMS with grid, PV, wind, and diesel generation into standardized, all-in-one, transportable, EPC-free energy storage products (FlexCombo, PowerCombo E5, FlexCombo D2, FlexCube C1). Its products are certified to UL9540, UL9540A, and NFPA855, and it offers an O&M platform plus bankability (DNV certified, AIG insured) for funded and insured projects. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Cubenergy publishes a corporate marketing site with no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Ecolectro
providers.description: Ecolectro is an Ithaca, New York materials-science company developing alkaline exchange membrane (AEM) technology for green hydrogen production. Its patented ionomers and membranes combine the low-cost, non-precious-metal chemistry of traditional alkaline electrolysis with the performance and efficiency of PEM electrolyzers, targeting roughly a 78% reduction in electrolyzer stack cost and a 33% reduction in the overall levelized cost of green hydrogen. A Cornell University spin-out backed by Techstars, Ecolectro partners with industrial gas and energy companies to manufacture and deploy its membrane materials at scale. Ecolectro publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Energy Vault
providers.description: Energy Vault Holdings (NYSE: NRGV) is a Swiss-founded, US-headquartered energy storage company delivering grid-scale storage hardware, software, and services worldwide. Its portfolio spans battery energy storage (B-VAULT), gravity-based storage (G-VAULT / EVx), and green-hydrogen storage (H-VAULT), unified by VaultOS, an energy management software platform providing real-time monitoring, operational control, and optimized dispatch across storage and generation assets, alongside Vault Bidder and Vault Manager for market bidding and asset management. The company serves utilities, independent power producers, and large energy users, with more than 1.4 GWh deployed since 2023. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Energy Vault is a frontier-tech company in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; VaultOS is delivered as a proprietary, deployment-integrated platform rather than a public API product.

providers.name: Lowercarbon Capital
providers.description: Lowercarbon Capital is a climate-focused venture capital firm that backs companies making real money by slashing CO2 emissions, removing carbon from the atmosphere, and buying the planet more time. The firm invests across energy, transportation, materials, agriculture, carbon removal, and planetary-cooling technologies, on the thesis that markets — not shame or guilt — will fix the climate. It was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and added to the API Evangelist network. Lowercarbon Capital publishes no public API or developer program; this profile captures the firm's identity and web properties.

providers.name: Project Canary
providers.description: Project Canary is a Denver-based climate technology company that helps oil and gas operators and natural gas utilities turn methane emissions data into operational intelligence. Founded in 2019, its Canary SENSE platform unifies measurement data from sensors, satellites, aircraft, SCADA, and field teams into a single view that drives decisions, reduces costs, and supports regulatory reporting (OGMP 2.0 and other frameworks). The company builds high-precision methane detection hardware (Canary RECON, Aeris PICO) and a proprietary predictive emissions model (methaneML) trained on a multi-year, high-fidelity methane dataset, serving upstream and midstream operators as well as gas distribution utilities across the United States. Project Canary has raised $121M (Series B) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and Techstars. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI is published at this time; this profile captures identity, a verbatim llms.txt, and security posture.

providers.name: ProLogium Technology
providers.description: ProLogium Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese energy-innovation company founded in 2006 that develops and manufactures next-generation solid-state lithium ceramic batteries built around a 100% ceramic separator. It commercialized its first solid-state cells in 2013, opened the world's first giga-level solid-state lithium ceramic battery plant in Taoyuan, Taiwan in 2024, and operates a European R&D center at Paris-Saclay with a planned gigafactory in Dunkirk, France. Its product lines span FLCB, PLCB and LLCB cells plus battery modules and packs, targeting electric vehicles, energy storage systems, robotics, and consumer and industrial applications. ProLogium is a hardware manufacturer: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Savion Aerospace
providers.description: Savion Aerospace (FlySavion) is an aerospace company developing sustainable, zero-emissions aviation technology. Its flagship SavionJet is an autonomous blended-wing-body (ABWB) aircraft with a standup cabin and satellite-based piloting via proprietary autonomous flight software, and the company offers Zero-Emissions Flight Credits (ZFCs) as a subscription for organizations seeking carbon-free air travel beyond offsetting. Savion demonstrated a cryogenic LNG-fueled flight in 2019 and is a 500 Global (500 Startups) and Alchemist Accelerator portfolio company. The company operates as an aviation hardware and services business and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: SunEdison
providers.description: SunEdison was a renewable energy company that developed, financed, installed, owned, and operated solar power plants and wind energy plants globally. Originally founded as MEMC Electronic Materials in 1959, SunEdison became the world's leading renewable energy developer before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in April 2016 and emerging as a restructured private company in 2017. No public developer API was documented.

providers.name: Verkor
providers.description: Verkor is a French cleantech manufacturer founded in 2020 to fast-track low-carbon lithium-ion battery production in Europe. Operating a "digital by design" industrial model, Verkor produces high-performance battery cells and modules for electric mobility and stationary energy storage, scaling through its Dunkerque Gigafactory toward 16 GWh of annual cell capacity to serve the European market. Verkor is a physical-products/industrial company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network. Backed by EQT Ventures.

providers.name: Aclarity Water
providers.description: Aclarity, Inc. (Aclarity Water) is a Medway, Massachusetts cleantech company that designs and manufactures on-site PFAS destruction technology. Its flagship Aclarity Octa system uses electrochemical oxidation to break the carbon-fluorine bond in per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), destroying these "forever chemicals" at landfills, centralized waste-treatment facilities, industrial sites (laundry, pulp and paper, automotive), municipal and industrial wastewater, drinking-water treatment, and AFFF-contaminated aviation sites. Aclarity is a portfolio company of DCVC. It is a physical water-treatment hardware and services business with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.

providers.name: Andes
providers.description: Andes (Andes Ag, Inc.) is a climate-technology and agricultural-biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Alameda, California. Andes engineers and selects beneficial soil microorganisms that are applied alongside seed in commodity row-crop production — corn, soybean, wheat and canola — where they accelerate the natural conversion of atmospheric carbon dioxide into stable soil inorganic carbon (carbonate minerals), a process the company calls Microbial Carbon Mineralization. Andes sells the resulting durable carbon dioxide removal as verified credits to corporate buyers and Scope 3 programs, and pays participating growers through the Andes Carbon Program. The company published the first Microbial Carbon Mineralization methodology, developed with EcoEngineers under ISO 14064, and has run field trials with Bayer, Cargill, Corteva, Nutrien and Wilbur-Ellis. Andes has raised roughly $38M, including a Series A co-led by Leaps by Bayer and Cavallo Ventures, and its shares trade on private secondary venues including EquityZen and Nasdaq Private Market. Andes publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Aruna
providers.description: Aruna is Indonesia's largest integrated fisheries commerce platform, on a mission to make the sea a better livelihood for all by building a fair and sustainable fisheries ecosystem. Aruna connects more than 40,000 small-scale fishermen to domestic and global markets using technology, a network of processing partners, and 177+ distribution hubs (Aruna Hubs) across the Indonesian archipelago, trading 23+ seafood commodity types into 31+ countries. The company pairs commerce with sustainability work, including fisherman education, fish-population tracking, and coastal-community empowerment. Aruna is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Canworks
providers.description: Canworks is a digital printing company specializing in direct‑to‑can aluminum printing for beverage brands. Based in the United States, it offers low‑minimum runs, fast turn‑around, and sustainable, sleeve‑free packaging solutions. The service includes artwork upload, prototyping, and full‑production printing, serving over 700 brands with high‑quality custom cans.

providers.name: DayOne
providers.description: DayOne is a hyperscale data center company delivering next-generation digital infrastructure for cloud, AI, and edge computing workloads. Spun out of the GDS International business and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, DayOne develops and operates strategically located, interconnected data center campuses across Asia-Pacific — Singapore, Johor (Malaysia), Batam (Indonesia), Hong Kong, Tokyo, and Bangkok — and is expanding into Europe with a launch market in Finland. The company positions itself as a build-to-suit and hyperscale partner focused on power availability, connectivity, and sustainable operations rather than as a public API or developer-platform provider; there is no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Encentive
providers.description: encentive GmbH is a German industrial energy-technology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Neumuenster. Its AI-driven smart energy management platform, flexOn, automatically optimizes and controls electricity consumption for industrial and commercial operations, orchestrating assets such as PV/solar systems, battery storage, heat pumps, cooling and thermal storage, CHP, wind, and EV charging infrastructure alongside existing energy management systems. flexOn combines plant data, weather forecasts, and real-time market prices to shift loads to periods when energy is cheapest and greenest, cutting energy costs by up to 20% and CO2 emissions by up to 30%. It integrates with industrial assets over REST API, SFTP, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP. encentive publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification; integration is delivered as part of its managed platform, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Evreka
providers.description: Evreka is a smart waste and recycling management technology company offering an end-to-end "Sustainability as a Service" platform that digitizes the entire waste management lifecycle. Its software suite spans operations, fleet, asset, MRF, and workforce management, route optimization, citizen engagement, and EPR/PRO management, complemented by IoT hardware such as fill-level sensors, vehicle and container trackers, and RFID readers. Evreka serves dumpster rental, recycling centers, medical, hazardous and liquid waste, construction and demolition, local authorities, and cross-border waste operators. Backed by 500 Global, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Fortera
providers.description: Fortera is a Silicon Valley materials-technology company advancing zero-CO2 cement. Its ReCarb process economically converts captured CO2 into ReAct green cement that meets regulatory standards and can be blended with or used in place of Ordinary Portland Cement inside existing production infrastructure. Fortera operates its first commercial ReCarb plant in Redding, California, holds 100+ patents, and is backed by Khosla Ventures and Temasek. The company is a climate-tech materials producer rather than a software/API provider; it publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Graphite Innovation and Technologies
providers.description: Graphite Innovation and Technologies Inc, operating as GIT Coatings, is a Canadian materials-science company that develops sustainable, graphene-based marine coatings for commercial ships. Its biocide-free hard foul-release hull and propeller coatings, including XGIT-FORCE, XGIT-VORTEX, and XGIT-PROP, cut fuel consumption, reduce drag, and eliminate leaching to protect the marine environment. The company is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. It is a physical-products manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and coverage.

providers.name: HONESS (Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection)
providers.description: HONESS (泓济环保 / Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection, honess.cn) is a Chinese environmental services provider founded in 2006, specializing in industrial wastewater treatment and the broader treatment of the "three wastes" (wastewater, waste gas, and hazardous waste). It offers customized environmental solutions, environmental equipment manufacturing and integration, EPC delivery for energy and chemical full-water systems, fine-chemical waste treatment, process packages for new and upgraded wastewater plants, and technology-enabled ("smart") digital operations and maintenance. The company holds top-grade design and contracting qualifications, has delivered 500+ design/build/operation projects for 300+ clients across China and abroad, and operates manufacturing and R&D bases in Shanghai and Anhui. It is not a developer/API company; the public surface is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or OAuth. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ideon Technologies
providers.description: Ideon Technologies (ideon.ai) develops REVEAL, a subsurface intelligence platform that uses muon tomography and geophysical inversion to image, map, and monitor mineral deposits and geological structures deep underground. It helps mining companies reduce geologic uncertainty across exploration, resource evaluation, geotechnical analysis, and cave monitoring, with customers including Rio Tinto, Vale, Glencore, and BHP. The company is backed by Playground Global. Ideon publishes a marketing and content web presence (solutions, case studies, papers, blog, careers) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: IKEA U.S.
providers.description: IKEA U.S. is the United States retail operation of IKEA, run by Ingka Group, the largest IKEA franchisee. The U.S. business operates ~50+ full-service stores, ~40+ Plan & Order Points, and ~80+ pick-up locations across the country, alongside the ikea.com/us e-commerce site and the IKEA mobile app. Inter IKEA Systems B.V. separately owns the IKEA Concept and brand. IKEA U.S. offers home furnishings, kitchens, appliances, lighting, the IKEA Family loyalty program, the IKEA Business Network for B2B customers, home delivery and Click & Collect, design and planning services, the Buy Back & Resell program, and IKEA Home smart products controlled via the IKEA Home smart and IKEA Home smart 1 apps. IKEA U.S. does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading-partner integrations are handled through IKEA's vendor systems and Ingka Group's internal digital platforms.

providers.name: Impossible Foods
providers.description: Impossible Foods is a Redwood City, California food-technology company that develops plant-based substitutes for meat, including Impossible Beef, Sausage, Chicken, Meatballs, and Pork. Founded in 2011 by Patrick O. Brown, the company engineers its products around heme (soy leghemoglobin) to replicate the taste and texture of animal meat while reducing the environmental footprint of food production. Its products are distributed through grocery retail and tens of thousands of restaurants across the United States and international markets including Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. Impossible Foods is a private, venture-backed company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Insempra
providers.description: Insempra is a biotechnology company that produces sustainable, bio-based ingredients using precision fermentation. It develops alternatives to petrochemical and naturally-extracted ingredients for the beauty and personal care, food and nutrition, and fibers and performance materials industries. Products include a bio-based Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol fragrance ingredient, an Omega-7 biolipid, and Biomelanin (in development), produced from agricultural and forestry waste streams through circular manufacturing. Insempra is a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Iwarranty
providers.description: iWarranty is a London-based, AI and machine-learning powered warranty management software platform that digitizes the entire warranty lifecycle for manufacturers, retailers, warrantors, and consumers. The platform covers QR-code product registration, automated claims processing and verification, repair and replacement coordination, fraud detection, and real-time product performance analytics, and integrates with existing ERP and CRM systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, and NetSuite. iWarranty emphasizes sustainability by reducing paper waste and e-waste through digitized processes. The company is backed by Anthemis and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network enrichment lead.

providers.name: Juna.ai
providers.description: Juna.ai is a Berlin-based industrial AI company building an Agentic Factory OS — a platform of autonomous AI agents that plan, steer, and continuously improve complex industrial production processes. Its agents ingest live plant data through integrations with existing IT/OT systems (SAP, Siemens, AVEVA, PI Server, Snowflake), model assets and processes into a Factory Graph and Knowledge Graph, detect anomalies, run root-cause analysis, generate reports, and recommend or execute control actions 24/7 with human-in-the-loop oversight and full traceability. Juna targets heavy and process industries including chemicals, cement, pulp & paper, glass, food & beverage, pharma, consumer goods, and industrial manufacturing, focused on maximizing output, quality, energy efficiency, and sustainability. The company is backed by Kleiner Perkins, Norrsken VC, and John Doerr. Juna delivers integration through enterprise engagements and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Material Evolution
providers.description: Material Evolution is a UK-based cleantech manufacturer of ultra-low carbon cement for the construction industry. Its MevoCem and MevoXL products use a proprietary "Alkali Fusion" process to transform industrial byproducts into cement feedstocks, achieving a 52.5N strength rating at roughly 144-196 kg CO2e per tonne versus ordinary Portland cement. The company operates compact, automated factories (including its Wrexham facility) and applies AI to material development and feedstock optimization. It is a B2B cement supplier and does not currently publish any public developer-facing API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Mombak
providers.description: Mombak is a Brazilian nature-based carbon removal company that acquires degraded and deforested land in the Amazon and restores it through large-scale, biodiverse reforestation with native species, generating high-integrity, high-quality carbon removal credits for corporate buyers. Founded by former Nubank executives and backed by investors including Union Square Ventures, the company combines science, technology, forestry, and carbon-market expertise to remove carbon at scale while restoring native ecosystems. Mombak operates as a corporate and carbon-markets business and publishes a public marketing and news presence; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Muon Space
providers.description: Muon Space is a Mountain View, California-based end-to-end space systems company that designs, builds, and operates mission-optimized satellite constellations to deliver Earth Intelligence and enable real-time compute and decision-making in space. Founded in 2021 by veterans of Skybox, NASA, and SpaceX, the company's core product is Muon Halo, an integrated technology stack composed of MuSim (constellation simulation and digital twin), MuOS (IP-based software-defined network middleware connecting space, ground, and cloud), MuCore (software-configurable instrument core), Condor (modular Condor-M and Condor-XL spacecraft platforms), and MuDash (cloud-based tasking, scheduling, and operations dashboard). Muon Space's flagship public mission is FireSat, a purpose-built wildfire detection and monitoring constellation developed with the Earth Fire Alliance, Google Research, and the Gordon & Betty Moore Foundation; FireSat carries a high-dynamic-range multispectral IR instrument capable of detecting 5x5 meter fires across a 1,500 km swath with a 50 m nadir ground sample distance, with revisit times targeted to twenty minutes once the full constellation is operational. The Protoflight satellite produced its first-light imagery in June 2025, with the first block of three additional satellites launching in 2026 and full operational capacity targeted for 2030. Other Muon Space missions support the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Space Force for next-generation weather monitoring, Hydrosat for thermal geospatial intelligence in climate and agriculture, and global security applications including missile-defense architecture. Muon Space's revenue model is mission contracting, spacecraft and constellation delivery, and hosted data services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release of the Halo platform or FireSat data feed.

providers.name: Propagate Ventures
providers.description: Propagate (formerly Propagate Ventures) is a regenerative-agriculture company founded in 2017 that helps farmland owners, farmers, and investors design, plant, finance, and manage agroforestry and tree-crop systems. Its flagship SaaS product, Overyield, lets farmers, developers, and investors model tree-crop economics, choose crops, and design tree-crop systems that work alongside existing farm operations. Propagate pairs the software with technical assessments, site prep and planting services, improved tree genetics, and ongoing project monitoring, and is a partner in the USDA Partnerships for Climate-Smart Commodities. The company advises 30,000+ acres of agroforestry supporting over 760,000 trees and shrubs. Propagate publishes no public API or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Regis Resources
providers.description: Regis Resources (ASX: RRL) is an unhedged Australian gold producer with operations at Duketon and Tropicana (a joint venture) in Western Australia and the McPhillamys gold project in New South Wales. Its website covers its assets, resources and reserves, sustainability, careers and investor information including ASX announcements. The company publishes no public developer API, documentation or developer portal on its own site; it was surfaced via the australia-apidays-2026 harvest.

providers.name: Shift EV
providers.description: Shift EV is an electric-mobility company that retrofits existing commercial vehicles to electric power through an "electrofitting" service, converting fleet vehicles to EV drivetrains in under an hour with zero upfront cost. The company designs and installs plug-and-play EV drivetrains, lithium-ion battery packs, on-site charging infrastructure, and fleet-management software for FMCG, e-commerce, service, and OEM fleets. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Shift EV was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Smallhold
providers.description: Smallhold is a specialty organic mushroom company founded in 2017 by Andrew Carter and Adam DeMartino and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. A Certified B Corporation, Smallhold grows gourmet mushroom varieties — including blue oyster, lion's mane, maitake, royal trumpet, and shiitake — using modular, automated "minifarm" growing environments designed for distributed, locally grown supply to grocery retailers and restaurants. Its public presence is a direct-to-consumer and retail-partner storefront built on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and run through the enrichment pipeline, which confirmed no bespoke API surface — only Shopify's platform OAuth discovery documents are exposed on the shop domain.

providers.name: Syntetica
providers.description: Syntetica is a French cleantech company using green chemistry to close the loop on synthetic textiles, starting with nylon. Its proprietary chemical process depolymerises nylon-blend fabrics, separating and purifying Nylon 6 and Nylon 6,6 from elastane, cotton, and other fibres in a single process to produce virgin-quality, low-carbon recycled polymers that drop in as replacements for fossil-derived nylon across textile, automotive, and high-performance applications. Backed by EQT Ventures, Bpifrance, SWEN Capital Partners, lululemon, and MAS Holdings, the company raised a $30M Series A in July 2026 to build its first commercial demonstration facility in France. Syntetica is a materials-science and manufacturing company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Treet
providers.description: Treet is a branded recommerce (resale) platform that lets e-commerce brands run their own secondhand marketplaces. Founded in 2021 by marketplace veterans Jake Disraeli and Sonia Yang (formerly of Indiegogo and Airbnb), Treet powers resale for 250+ global brands through four stackable programs: Peer-to-Peer (customers buy and sell from each other for cash or brand credit), Trade-In, Off-Price liquidation of excess inventory, and Returns rerouting. Treet integrates into a brand's existing commerce stack — Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, WooCommerce and Salesforce Commerce, plus logistics (ShipHero, ShipBob), marketing/loyalty (Klaviyo, Yotpo, LoyaltyLion) and returns (Loop, Happy Returns) partners via its "Infinite Integrations" platform. Treet is an API consumer rather than an API producer: it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks of its own, and delivers to brands as a managed SaaS and Shopify app. Backed by Two Sigma Ventures and Techstars.

providers.name: TruckLabs
providers.description: TruckLabs built TruckWings, an automated tractor-mounted aerodynamic device that closes the gap between the tractor and trailer to reduce aerodynamic drag, cutting fuel consumption by a proven 3-6% and eliminating roughly 7-10 metric tons of CO2 per truck each year with an 18-24 month payback. The device deploys automatically at highway speed and retracts below it, reduces buffeting and trailer sway in crosswinds, and installs on both new builds and retrofits in about two hours. TruckLabs was acquired by ConMet, and trucklabs.com now redirects to the ConMet TruckWings product line. As a hardware fuel-efficiency company, TruckLabs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture. Backed by Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Aigen
providers.description: Aigen ("AI Generated Agriculture") is a Kirkland, Washington robotics company founded in 2020 that builds fully autonomous, solar-powered farm robots for daily, chemical-free weed control. Its flagship product, the Element, uses AI vision to identify and mechanically strike weeds — including herbicide-resistant weeds — with no herbicides, running on solar power with onboard battery storage and coordinating as a crew over a mesh network. In 2026 Aigen introduced Alchemy, a generative world model for outdoor physical AI that produces self-labeling synthetic training data. Aigen sells a managed robotics-as-a-service engagement rather than a self-serve developer product: growers are onboarded through a local Aigen agent and an intake form, and Aigen operates and maintains the fleet through the growing season. As of this profile Aigen publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Finres
providers.description: Finres (finres SAS) is a French climate-risk analytics company building a decision platform for agriculture. It translates climate hazards into economic consequences for farms, agricultural value chains and territories, combining agronomic, pedological, climate and market data with AI models that are peer-reviewed and validated against published research. Two productized offerings sit on top of the platform - a farm-level economic and climate viability diagnostic (DPEC, currently in beta, seeded from a grower's TelePAC parcel file and reference datasets such as Agreste, IPPAP and RICA) and bespoke territorial or sector studies. Finres was founded by Florent Baarsch, previously with the World Bank, the United Nations and climate research institutes, and its customers include the French government, the World Bank, the Green Climate Fund, IFAD and the FAO. The company markets high-resolution data delivery into customer decision systems, but as of this enrichment pass publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification or SDK - access is arranged through a sales demo.

providers.name: Westbound Equity Partners
providers.description: Westbound Equity Partners is a venture capital firm that invests financial and social capital into values-aligned founding teams, aiming to build a virtuous cycle of wealth and opportunity. The firm backs ventures across workplace equity and wealth-building, climate tech and decarbonization, AI and advanced technology, and social impact, and supports founders through the Westbound Network of entrepreneurs, operators, and investors plus culture coaching and talent services. Portfolio companies include Esusu, Planet FWD, Syndio, Sierra, Mon Ami, The Browser Company, Conduit Tech, Manas AI, and Laborup. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Westbound publishes a marketing and careers website but no public developer or API program.

providers.name: Cleanaway
providers.description: Cleanaway (Cleanaway Waste Management Limited, ASX-listed) is Australia's leading waste management and resource recovery company. It provides sustainable waste management, recycling, liquid and hazardous waste, and industrial services to businesses, councils and communities across Australia, helping them turn waste into valuable resources. Surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (australia-apidays-2026); no public developer API was found on its website.

providers.name: Conapto
providers.description: Conapto provides scalable, secure and sustainable data center colocation and cloud connectivity services. Based in Sweden, Conapto offers flexible colocation solutions, interconnect, cloud‑connect, and sale‑leaseback options for enterprises seeking reliable infrastructure with low carbon footprint. The company emphasizes climate‑responsible operations, high availability, and competitive electricity costs, serving customers across Europe and globally.

providers.name: Copernicus
providers.description: Copernicus is the European Union’s Earth observation programme, providing free, open access to satellite data and services that monitor the environment, climate, and security. It delivers a wide range of products from Sentinel satellites, enabling applications in agriculture, disaster management, climate change, and more. The programme supports public authorities, businesses, and researchers with timely, high‑resolution imagery and analytics, fostering innovation and sustainable development across Europe and globally.

providers.name: Elephantech
providers.description: Elephantech Inc. (founded January 2014 in Tokyo as AgIC Inc., renamed Elephantech in September 2017) develops, manufactures and sells precision metal inkjet printing equipment, advanced conductive materials, and flexible printed circuit board products, including its SustainaCircuits multilayer PCB line and NeuralJet printing technology. The company positions itself as decarbonizing electronics manufacturing by replacing subtractive copper etching with additive inkjet deposition. It is a hardware and materials manufacturer with roughly 150 employees, headquartered at 4-3-8 Hatchobori, Chuo-ku, Tokyo; it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Flowcarbon
providers.description: Flowcarbon is a climate-finance company that provides project finance and bespoke capital solutions for companies working in infrastructure, decarbonization, and frontier climate industries. Its end-to-end services span project origination, screening and due diligence, deal structuring, and tax-credit solutions, with a focus on engineered carbon-removal technologies such as biochar and enhanced rock weathering. Founded with a web3 heritage in tokenized voluntary carbon credits and backed by a16z and General Catalyst, Flowcarbon today operates primarily as a climate project-finance firm rather than a developer platform, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Jimmy
providers.description: Jimmy (Jimmy Energy SAS) is a French nuclear-technology company, founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the CEA, that designs, builds and operates small modular high-temperature reactors it calls thermal generators — helium-cooled HTR units the company describes as bus-sized — to deliver carbon-free process heat directly to industrial sites under secured 20-year supply-and-price contracts. Jimmy is headquartered in Paris with an industrial platform at Le Creusot in Burgundy, targets food, paper, sugar and chemicals producers that currently burn natural gas for process heat, and filed the first SMR creation-authorization request in France for a generator at the Cristanol site in Bazancourt. Jimmy sells heat, not software: it publishes no API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification, and this profile records that measured absence rather than assuming it.

providers.name: Praan
providers.description: Praan (Praan Climate Technologies) is a deep-tech climate startup working to democratize access to clean, healthy air and to rebuild the atmosphere by capturing air pollution and greenhouse gases with novel filterless technology. Its products include HIVE, an air-purification device for homes and commercial spaces paired with a companion mobile application, and MK II, an air-purification system for industrial environments. Praan is backed by Prosus Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched through the API Evangelist pipeline; as of this pass Praan publishes a consumer hardware and mobile-app surface but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: Schuettflix
providers.description: Schuettflix is a German digital logistics platform for the construction industry, founded in 2018 in Guetersloh. It operates a neutral B2B marketplace that connects construction companies, bulk-material suppliers, freight forwarders and waste-disposal firms in a single fully digital workflow. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers order sand, gravel and crushed stone with transparent real-time pricing, coordinate dispatch and transport, capture delivery documentation, manage routes, and handle mineral-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling of construction materials. The company digitizes the traditionally analog and fragmented process of procuring and delivering bulk goods, earning a commission on the transactions facilitated through its platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Aquamembranes
providers.description: Aquamembranes provides optimized reverse osmosis technology with patented, precision printed elements that improve industrial RO systems. Their solutions lower energy costs, reduce cleaning cycles, and boost water recovery without retrofits. The company serves global leaders in water treatment, offering products, resources, and design software to enhance system performance.

providers.name: Banyan Infrastructure
providers.description: Banyan Infrastructure provides project finance software for infrastructure funds, developers, and green banks. Their platform unifies workflow and data across origination, underwriting, portfolio management, and compliance, accelerating capital flow into infrastructure projects. The solution replaces fragmented systems like Salesforce and Excel with a single data layer, supporting owners, operators, and financiers.

providers.name: EcoDataCenter
providers.description: EcoDataCenter is a European leader in sustainable compute infrastructure, operating high‑performance data centers across Sweden. Founded in Sweden, the company combines world‑class engineering with minimal climate impact, offering services that enable customers to achieve net‑zero goals while scaling seamlessly. EcoDataCenter focuses on efficiency, renewable energy use, and transparent sustainability reporting, positioning itself as a pioneer in green data center solutions for the European market.

providers.name: Aday
providers.description: Aday is a direct-to-consumer sustainable fashion brand founded in 2015 in New York City by Nina Faulhaber and Meg He. It designs technical, long-lasting capsule wardrobes built for outfit repetition, using custom recycled fabrics (including post-consumer recycled plastic) and plant-based, beechwood-derived materials produced in closed-loop processes. Aday has raised more than $10 million in venture capital, is backed by Cowboy Ventures, and has been named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, with coverage in Vogue, Refinery29, and Conde Nast Traveler. The company sells globally through its Shopify-powered storefront at thisisaday.com and does not publish a public developer API. This profile was created as an API Evangelist network stub from Cowboy Ventures' portfolio and enriched with company identity and domain-security signals; the storefront returned a Shopify "store is unavailable" lock at the time of the enrichment probe.

providers.name: Amyris
providers.description: Amyris, Inc. is a synthetic-biology and precision-fermentation company that engineers microbes to convert plant-derived sugars into high-performance renewable molecules — including farnesene, squalene, squalane, and bisabolol — at industrial scale. The company offers strain development, process development, piloting, scale-up, and manufacturing services for custom renewable chemistry used across personal care, cosmetics, flavors and fragrances, and other industries, emphasizing resilient supply chains, product consistency, and reduced ecological impact. Amyris is a private company that emerged from a 2023 Chapter 11 restructuring; it does not currently publish a public developer API or technology platform.

providers.name: Bland Company
providers.description: The Bland Company is a London-based food-technology and biotechnology startup building functional plant proteins that replace eggs in food manufacturing. Its feedstock-agnostic process upcycles underused agricultural side streams into flavor-neutral, cost-stable proteins engineered to match animal-protein functionality — solubility, foaming, gelling, and emulsifying — for bakery, sauces, beverages, and snacks. The company raised a ~$2.7M pre-seed round led by Initialized Capital. It publishes no public developer API surface (no docs, SDKs, or GitHub); this profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead.

providers.name: BlocPower
providers.description: BlocPower is a Brooklyn-based climate technology and building decarbonization company, founded in 2014 as a Public Benefit Corporation, that makes urban buildings smarter, greener, and healthier with a focus on historically underserved communities. It combines deep building-science expertise with accessible financing to deliver energy-efficiency retrofits and electrification measures such as heat pumps, pairing construction management with clean-energy upgrades. As of late 2023 BlocPower reported more than 1,200 completed measures across 1,100+ buildings nationwide, thousands of metric tons of CO2e reduced, and hundreds of local job placements, earning recognition from the White House, EPA, and TIME. BlocPower is a portfolio company of a16z and is tracked in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Bright
providers.description: Bright is Mexico's leading residential and commercial solar energy provider, founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15) by Jonah Greenberger. Often described as "Sunrun for the developing world," Bright combines financing and software to let homeowners and businesses adopt rooftop solar and battery energy storage (BESS) at no upfront cost. The company operates a marketplace connecting a network of local installers, distributors, and retail promoters with customers, and offers financing models such as solar PPAs and leasing schemes. Bright's public web presence is a Wix-hosted marketing site (thinkbright.mx) covering its industrial, commercial, and home solutions, success cases, and 24/7 energy monitoring technology. It exposes an agent-facing surface via an llms.txt and a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint, but publishes no first-party developer/REST API.

providers.name: Council on Environmental Quality
providers.description: The Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) is an office within the Executive Office of the President of the United States that coordinates federal environmental policy, advises the President on environmental and natural resource policies, and oversees the implementation of the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA). CEQ does not publish a public developer API. Federal NEPA documents and related environmental data are surfaced through partner federal agencies and platforms (NEPAtool, the Federal Permitting Dashboard, regulations.gov, EPA EJScreen, and the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool).

providers.name: Finnish Meteorological Institute
providers.description: The Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI) provides observations, research and services on the atmosphere, near‑space and seas. It offers public‑safety weather forecasts, climate data, marine information and scientific research for citizens, businesses and authorities in Finland and worldwide.

providers.name: HelioRec
providers.description: HelioRec is a floating photovoltaic (FPV) engineering and manufacturing company that designs and builds floating solar power plants for lakes, reservoirs, and nearshore waters. It uses an engineering-led, load-based methodology focused on structural behavior, mooring integrity, installation practicality, and long-term operability on water, delivering grid-connected, utility-scale systems engineered for real water conditions. HelioRec serves independent power producers and utilities, hydropower and reservoir owners, industrial and infrastructure operators, and water and agriculture stakeholders, supporting projects from site-specific concept through execution. The company is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED
providers.description: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED (Neo Mobility) is a UAE-based B2B electric-mobility startup driving sustainable transportation across the MENA region. Neo bundles electric-vehicle fleets, charging infrastructure, an integrated fleet/driver/operations/energy management platform, driver-safety programs, and human-capital support into a single subscription-based ecosystem — delivering EV Delivery-as-a-Service for e-commerce, food delivery, and last-mile logistics, alongside e-taxi mobility. The company publishes no public developer or API program; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network discovery.

providers.name: Remora
providers.description: Remora is a carbon-capture startup (legally Echeneidae Inc.) founded in 2020 and based in Wixom, Michigan, that retrofits semi-trucks and locomotives with zero-backpressure devices which extract and purify up to 90 percent of the CO2 from vehicle exhaust while cutting other pollutants. The company then sells the captured, purified carbon dioxide and shares the resulting revenue with the transportation operators it partners with. Remora is a hardware and climate-technology business with no public API or developer platform; this profile tracks it as an API Evangelist network company for portfolio and discovery purposes.

providers.name: TRIC Robotics
providers.description: TRIC Robotics builds autonomous agricultural robots that replace chemical pesticides with ultraviolet light. Its flagship platform, Luna, is a tractor-scale robot that roams California strawberry fields after dark, using UV-C light to kill fungal pathogens such as powdery mildew and botrytis while a mechanical "Bug Vac" removes pests like Lygus bugs, spotted wing drosophila, and spider mites — without a single drop of pesticide. Founded in 2017 by Dr. Adam Stager and Vishnu Somasundaram out of the University of Delaware and now based in California, TRIC operates a robotics-as-a-service model that requires no upfront investment from growers, and reports pesticide reductions of up to 70% across the farms it serves. The company raised a $5.5M seed round led by Version One Ventures to expand its fleet across Santa Maria, Oxnard, and Watsonville. TRIC Robotics is an agricultural robotics operator and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Windfall Bio
providers.description: Windfall Bio transforms methane emissions into organic fertilizer and carbon credits using proprietary non-GMO methane-eating microbes (methanotrophs). The company operates across agriculture, coal mining, oil & gas, and waste management, capturing methane at the source and converting it into a soil amendment while generating verifiable carbon credits. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the latest enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: 280 Earth
providers.description: 280 Earth is a direct air capture (DAC) company that permanently removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Originally launched in 2018 inside X, the Alphabet moonshot factory, and spun out as an independent company in 2022, it is backed by Sergey Brin, Builders VC and a $50M Series B.
