Its proprietary sorbent moves through a gravity-fed dual-chamber system that continuously cycles material between capturing and releasing CO2, running on low-grade industrial waste heat or clean electricity and producing fresh water as a byproduct. Its first pilot plant, in The Dalles, Oregon, captures 500 tons of CO2 per year on a site sized for more than 20,000 tons per year at full build-out, and underpins a $40M offtake agreement with the Frontier carbon removal buyer consortium (Google, Meta, Stripe, Shopify and others). 280 Earth is a hardware and carbon-removal operator; as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer surface, API, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Forterausa
providers.description: Forterausa, now operating as Fortera Global, develops low‑carbon cement technologies that reduce CO₂ emissions in construction. The company offers the ReAct product line and ReCarb plants, providing data, documentation, and carbon credit solutions to accelerate sustainable building practices worldwide. Backed by Khosla Ventures and other investors, Fortera aims to scale economical, low‑CO₂ cement production for global infrastructure projects.

providers.name: Mighty Buildings
providers.description: Mighty Buildings is a construction-technology and advanced-manufacturing company that industrializes homebuilding using large-format 3D printing, proprietary polymer-composite materials and robotic automation. Founded in 2019 and originally based in Oakland, California, it raised more than $150 million from investors including Khosla Ventures, Bold Capital and Aramco's Wa'ed Ventures, and was the first company certified under the UL 3401 standard for evaluating building structures and assemblies, as well as being certified under California's Factory Built Housing program. Its current product is the Mighty Kit System / Mighty Wall System - factory-made complete wall panels that arrive on site with integrated structure, insulation, waterproofing and exterior finish, so builders assemble a building envelope with conventional methods and fewer on-site steps. After a January 2025 restructuring and sale process, the full suite of Mighty Buildings technologies was acquired by LUMUS Inc., and Mighty Buildings now operates as a LUMUS brand headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon. The company sells physical building systems to developers and builders; it operates no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Twig
providers.description: Twig (twig.bio) is a UK biotechnology company using artificial intelligence and machine learning to design sustainable bioengineered ingredients — "AI defined ingredients that don't cost the earth." Its proprietary twig:tech platform pairs bio:drive, an AI/ML design engine that generates and scores novel microbe designs across pathway and enzyme selection, gene edits, and expression levels, with grow:bot, an automated high-throughput lab that builds and tests those designs and feeds every result back into the next design cycle. Twig aims to cultivate clean ingredients from bacteria via fermentation rather than extracting them from the ground or sea or producing them with fossil fuels. Twig is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is backed by additional early-stage investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead; Twig currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface — its api./app. subdomains resolve to internal infrastructure — so this pass captures company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Veolia
providers.description: A French multinational corporation and the global leader in environmental services including water management, waste management, and energy services. Operates in nearly 50 countries providing solutions for water treatment, waste recycling, and pollution remediation.

providers.name: Ayr Energy
providers.description: Ayr Energy is a power grid equipment manufacturer founded in 2024 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, backed by General Catalyst. The company designs and builds custom-engineered electrical infrastructure - power, distribution, and special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear - for renewable energy, data center, utility, industrial, and oil & gas customers. Ayr operates six manufacturing facilities across India (Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu) and emphasizes accelerated delivery of grid hardware in months rather than years. Ayr Energy does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CarbonChain
providers.description: CarbonChain is a London- and New York-based carbon accounting platform founded in 2019 that is purpose-built for the highest-emitting, hardest-to- track commodity supply chains — metals and mining, energy, manufacturing, and agriculture. Its AI-assisted platform builds asset- and transaction- level emissions pictures using activity-based emission factors, and packages those calculations into modules for supply-chain emissions, corporate carbon footprints (Scope 1, 2, 3), product carbon footprints, scenario analysis, and regulatory compliance. The flagship CarbonChain Comply release ships a Carbon Reporting Hub aligned with EU CSRD, UK SECR, US SEC, and CDP, along with EU/UK CBAM declaration validation, automated CBAM XML generation, and a Supplier Engagement Module for collecting and validating supplier emissions data. CarbonChain Connect links producers and importers through shared installation-level CBAM infrastructure. The company is a CDP Accredited Provider (2024), is ISO 27001 certified, and is backed by Y Combinator, Union Square Ventures, Voyager VC, and Aera VC, with $10M Series A funding (2023). CarbonChain serves manufacturers, commodity traders, banks, and procurement teams, and offers system-to-system API integration for delivering activity data in and pulling gold-standard emissions calculations out — but it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source client library. API access is offered as part of customer integration projects rather than as a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Lizee
providers.description: Lizee is a Paris-based Retail-as-a-Service platform that helps brands and retailers launch and operate circular commerce programs — rental, resale, and second-hand — end to end. Its stack pairs a rental platform, a resale/e-commerce platform, and a logistics platform (returns, refurbishment, reverse logistics) behind an operations API so a brand can offer rent or buy-back experiences on top of its existing catalog. Lizee runs a production API (api.lizee.io) and publishes a public Atlassian Statuspage, though it does not expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs — the API surface is partner and integration facing. Lizee was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Speedinvest.

providers.name: Silgan Holdings
providers.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is a leading global sustainable packaging provider for consumer goods products. The company partners with customers to deliver essential products to the world in efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective packaging formats. Silgan operates through three primary business segments: Dispensing and Specialty Closures, Metal Containers, and Custom Containers. With 123 manufacturing facilities on four continents, over 17,200 employees, and approximately $6 billion in annual sales, Silgan serves the food, beverage, healthcare, home and garden, personal care, fragrance, and beauty end markets.

providers.name: BMKG
providers.description: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) is the Indonesian government agency responsible for weather forecasting, climate monitoring, and geophysical observations. It provides public information on meteorological conditions, climate data, earthquake and tsunami alerts, and other geoscience services across Indonesia.

providers.name: Boliden
providers.description: Boliden is a Swedish mining and smelting company that extracts and processes metals such as copper, zinc, gold, and silver. The company operates mines and smelters across Europe, focusing on sustainable practices, safety, and community engagement. Boliden’s website provides information on its operations, corporate governance, environmental policies, and career opportunities, reflecting its commitment to responsible metal production for generations.

providers.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
providers.description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS) is a commercial fusion energy company headquartered in Devens, Massachusetts and spun out of the MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center in 2018. CFS is developing tokamak-based fusion systems built around high-temperature superconducting (HTS) REBCO magnet technology that enables substantially smaller, faster, and lower-cost fusion machines than prior generations. The company's technology pipeline starts with SPARC, a net-energy demonstration tokamak under construction at the Devens campus, and continues with ARC, the planned first commercial fusion power plant, sited in Chesterfield County, Virginia in partnership with Dominion Energy and targeted to deliver approximately 400 MW of electricity to the grid in the early 2030s. CFS is backed by a deep investor base including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Eni, Equinor, Google, Temasek, Tiger Global, Khosla Ventures, Bill Gates, Soros Fund Management, Lowercase Capital, John Doerr, and TIME Ventures. CFS does not publish a public developer API or SDK; engagement is via partnerships, careers, and investor channels.

providers.name: Lilac Solutions
providers.description: Lilac Solutions is an Oakland, California climate-technology company founded in 2016 that develops direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology built on proprietary ion exchange media. Its ion exchange beads and modular brine processing systems pull battery-grade lithium from high-grade, low-grade and complex brines without evaporation ponds, cutting water use and shrinking the land footprint and time-to-production of conventional lithium operations. Lilac operates mini-pilot, field-pilot and commercial deployments across the Great Salt Lake in Utah, Nevada, Argentina, Chile, Germany and Indonesia, and manufactures its ion exchange media on a dedicated production line in Nevada. The company is venture-backed with roughly $350M raised, employs about 200 people, and sells industrial hardware and process technology to lithium producers — it publishes no public developer platform, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Skeleton Technologies
providers.description: Skeleton Technologies is an Estonian-German energy storage manufacturer, founded in Tartu, Estonia in 2009 by Oliver Ahlberg and Taavi Madiberk, that designs and builds high-power supercapacitor and SuperBattery systems on its patented Curved Graphene material. Its product line spans SkelCap ultracapacitor cells, supercapacitor modules, and the GrapheneUPS, GrapheneGPU and GrapheneBBU power systems aimed at AI data centers, grid stability, defense, automotive, heavy transportation and industrial customers. The company has raised close to EUR 400 million, counts Marubeni and Siemens among its backers, and manufactures at its ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 certified Leipzig Superfactory in Germany, a Varkaus facility in Finland and a Curved Graphene plant in Bitterfeld-Wolfen. Skeleton sells physical power hardware; it operates no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Addionics
providers.description: Addionics is a Smart Metals manufacturer headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with operations in Israel, Korea and the USA, building Smart 3D Porous Current Collectors that replace the flat copper and aluminium foils inside a battery cell with a porous, ion-permeable metal architecture. The technology is chemistry-agnostic and drop-in, produced roll-to-roll on existing coating lines, and is sold into robotics, defence, space and EV programmes. Addionics is a hardware and materials company: it operates no developer program and publishes no API, SDK, webhook or machine-readable API contract. It does run a deliberate agent-readable content surface on its own domain — a served /llms.txt digest, a published /agents.md agent guide, a markdown twin of every page under Accept: text/markdown, a complete /sitemap.xml and an RSS blog feed — all captured in this profile.

providers.name: Camion
providers.description: Camion is an infrastructure-intelligence platform accelerating the electrification of real estate portfolios. Its AI-driven platform indexes properties by their readiness and potential for electrification, forecasts energy demand, and optimizes the placement of solar, storage, and EV-charging infrastructure so the largest real estate owners and infrastructure developers can underwrite and deploy energy upgrades at scale. Camion positions itself as an "always-on energy department" that delivers consultant-grade investment cases without manual dashboard monitoring. Founded in 2023 and based in London, Camion raised a EUR 2.7M pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures in April 2024. Sector: energy-and-environmental. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; Camion publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: CleanCapital
providers.description: CleanCapital is a New York based clean energy investment firm, founded in 2015, that develops, constructs, acquires, owns and operates distributed-generation solar and energy storage projects across the United States. It concentrates on the commercial and municipal middle market between residential rooftop and utility-scale generation, selling power to businesses, schools, nonprofits, municipalities and community solar subscribers, and it buys operating and late-stage development projects from developers through a dedicated project-acquisition practice. The firm reports more than $1.5 billion of capital deployed, 450+ MW under management, 235 MW developed and constructed, 200+ energy customers and over 1,000 GWh of emissions-free generation, backed by institutional partners including Manulife Investment Management / John Hancock, BlackRock and CarVal Investors. CleanCapital is an asset owner and investment manager rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its customer portal at app.cleancapital.com now redirects to the third-party Dock Energy platform.

providers.name: ECO2GROW
providers.description: ECO2GROW is a German renewable-energy procurement company serving mid-sized businesses. It builds an individually optimized electricity procurement mix that combines Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) sourced directly from German solar and wind farms with spot-market and forward contracts, giving companies enterprise-level pricing, long-term fixed rates, and traceable green power. The service automates the optimization of a company's procurement strategy and reduces the complexity and transaction costs of closing a PPA, helping industrial and mid-market buyers lower CO2 emissions through verifiable renewable sourcing. ECO2GROW is a Techstars portfolio company. As a B2B energy procurement and advisory business it operates a marketing/consulting web presence and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Greenlyte
providers.description: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies is an Essen, Germany based climate-tech company building its LiquidSolar platform, which liquefies air, sun, and water into 99% pure carbon and hydrogen feedstocks to produce synthetic e-fuels (sustainable aviation fuel, synthetic methanol, and synthetic natural gas) for hard-to-decarbonize industries. Founded as a direct air capture and power-to-liquid venture, Greenlyte has raised more than 55M EUR from Carbon Removal Partners, Earlybird, Partech, AENU, and Green Generation Fund. It was surfaced through VC portfolio mining and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Greenlyte publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface; this profile captures its verifiable web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Involve Space
providers.description: Involve Space is an Italian stratospheric aerospace company building real-time Earth intelligence. It operates autonomous high-altitude balloon platforms (Stratostats) that loiter around 20 kilometers for hours, days, or weeks to deliver continuous, high-resolution Earth observation, bridging the gap between satellites, drones, and ground sensors. Its Neurostar AI flight software autonomously controls individual balloons and networks of them (LoonHive), while the CLEAR GeoAI platform turns captured imagery into geospatial insights for disaster response, infrastructure and environmental monitoring, security, and in-orbit-demonstration / payload validation. A certified B Corporation headquartered in Italy with U.S. operations at the Houston Spaceport, Involve Space is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital, CDP Venture Capital, and an EIC Accelerator grant.

providers.name: Lyten
providers.description: Lyten is a San Jose, California advanced-materials company founded in 2015 that invented and commercializes Lyten 3D Graphene, a tunable three-dimensional carbon supermaterial produced by converting methane into nanostructured carbon while co-producing hydrogen. Lyten applies that materials platform across four product lines: lithium-sulfur battery cells and battery systems that contain no cobalt, nickel or manganese and target roughly 40% weight savings versus lithium-ion; 3D graphene reinforced 3D printer filament; concrete admixture and structural adhesives; and chemical/environmental sensors, including the Lyten Atmos continuous methane-intelligence platform that pairs solar-powered LTE field sensors with cloud analytics and dashboards for landfill and oil-and-gas emissions monitoring. The company has raised over $600 million from investors including Stellantis, FedEx and Honeywell, operates a 145,000 sq ft pilot manufacturing facility in the Alviso district of North San Jose, acquired Cuberg's San Leandro battery assets in 2024, and in 2025 acquired Northvolt battery manufacturing assets in Poland and Sweden, establishing a European headquarters in Gdansk, Poland. Lyten is a private company; its shares trade on secondary markets such as Forge Global. It publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: Matter Intelligence
providers.description: Matter Intelligence is a California-based remote sensing and physical-AI company founded in 2024 by former NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory engineers Vishnu Sridhar and Thomas Chrien with former Caltech scientist Nathan Stein. The company builds ultraspectral imaging sensors that capture roughly 2,000 spectral bands from deep ultraviolet through thermal infrared — enough to read the molecular chemistry of a surface rather than only its color — and pairs them with Large Geospatial Models that reason over that data. Its sensors are designed for satellites, aircraft, drones and robots, and its first satellite, EARTH-1, is intended to deliver sub-meter hyperspectral and thermal imaging and to build a global encyclopedia of Earth's material composition. Target applications named on its site include mining and mineral exploration, agriculture, insurance and risk, infrastructure monitoring, emissions and methane detection, and defense ISR. The company emerged from stealth in October 2024 with a $12M seed round led by Lowercarbon Capital, with Toyota Ventures, Pear VC, E2MC and Mark Cuban participating. As of this profile it is pre-launch and pre-product: matter.com is a marketing site with an Early Access request form, and Matter Intelligence publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Plant Prefab
providers.description: Plant Prefab is a Southern California offsite construction technology company that custom-fabricates panelized and modular building components to deliver housing and hospitality projects in roughly half the time of traditional site-built construction. Its panel-based building system spans open-cavity panels to fully finished modules, and its LivingHomes product line and in-house Plant Design Studio offer customized, sustainable designs recognized with LEED Platinum, NAHB Energy Value Housing, and AIA Top Ten Green Projects awards. The company is backed by Obvious Ventures and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Realta Fusion
providers.description: Realta Fusion is a fusion-energy company developing compact, scalable, modular magnetic-mirror fusion systems branded CoSMo fusion to deliver zero-carbon heat and electricity for industrial energy needs. Backed by Khosla Ventures, the company designs prefabricated fusion modules that can be assembled to meet a variety of industrial power and process-heat requirements, targeting decarbonization of the roughly 37 billion metric tons of annual CO2 emissions from energy production. Realta Fusion is a hardware and energy-systems company and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks it in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Rizm
providers.description: RIZM is a holistic energy optimization platform for industrial enterprises, operated by Kerith GmbH of Münster, Germany. It integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure into a digital twin, then optimizes energy system design and day-to-day operational decisions — from long-term infrastructure investment and power purchase agreements to short-term asset dispatch and production scheduling — helping manufacturers cut energy costs and emissions at the same time. Named customers include BMW Group, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, and BSH. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application (app.rizm.de) with authenticated documentation; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time. Backed by Point Nine, this profile was surfaced from the venture portfolio graph.

providers.name: Sizable Energy
providers.description: Sizable Energy is a Milan, Italy based clean-energy company developing offshore pumped hydro energy storage. Its patented system pairs subsea and floating reservoirs connected by pipes with reversible pump-turbines that move saturated sea-salt brine between them to deliver long-duration, grid-scale energy storage. The modular, scalable design leverages proven pumped-hydro technology with zero land use and integrates with floating wind and solar installations. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Playground Global; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Skyfri
providers.description: Skyfri is a cleantech software and hardware company headquartered in Oslo, Norway that builds an operating platform for owners and operators of solar and battery energy assets. Founded in 2021, Skyfri combines an edge-native monitoring and control device (the SSI hardware, which speaks Modbus and SCADA over isolated RS-485 ports to inverters, meters, and sensors) with a cloud platform that automates operations, maintenance, and asset performance management. The software delivers real-time data processing, operational management, weather forecasting, dynamic benchmarking, plant insights, and fault detection to monitor generation and address underperformance and equipment failure across a global portfolio of solar and battery assets. The company has offices in Denver, London, Oslo, Singapore, and Bangalore and is backed by Speedinvest. Skyfri exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time; its platform is delivered as a customer application at app.skyfri.com.

providers.name: Sleek EV
providers.description: Sleek EV (SLEEK EV) is a Thai-Singaporean electric motorcycle company founded in 2022, headquartered in Singapore with primary operations in Thailand. Under the mission "Sustainability must be affordable," it builds accessible electric two-wheelers — the TYPE-S, TYPE-E and TYPE-X motorcycles and the SLEEK Play 1.0 urban scooter — powered by its S-DRIVE powertrain and IP67-rated lithium-ion batteries (via Ampace/CATL). It runs the S-Charge fast-charging network (100+ stations across Bangkok) and a SLEEK App for vehicle monitoring, route planning and station finding, sold through a nationwide dealer network. BOI-certified and backed by ORZON Ventures (OR + 500 TukTuks), January Capital, A2D Ventures and Krungsri Finnovate. This is a consumer product company with no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: United Solar
providers.description: United Solar (United Solar Polysilicon FZC SPC) is a clean-technology company producing ultra-high-purity polysilicon for the photovoltaic industry from one of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities in Oman's Sohar Free Zone, with an annual capacity of 100,000 metric tons supporting roughly 40 GW of solar module production. Backed by IDG Capital and the IFC, the company completed a $1.6 billion capital raise in 2026 and is the largest polysilicon producer of its kind outside China. United Solar is an industrial manufacturer and does not publish a developer portal or public APIs.

providers.name: XFuel
providers.description: XFuel develops, patents, and deploys technologies that transform diverse waste into low-carbon drop-in transport fuels, using its Chemical Liquid Refining (CLR) and Mechanical Carbon Conversion (MECC) processes to produce marine (ISO 8217 DMA), road (EN590), and in-development sustainable aviation fuels. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with operations in Bunyola, Spain, and backed by Union Square Ventures. XFuel publishes no public API or developer program as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: AgroUrbana
providers.description: AgroUrbana SpA is a Chilean vertical-farming company founded in 2018 in Santiago by Pablo Bunster and Cristian Sjogren, and widely described as the first commercial vertical farm in Latin America. It runs climate-controlled indoor grow facilities combining hydroponics, spectrum-programmed LED lighting, renewable energy, automation and data analytics to produce leafy greens year round, reporting up to twelve growing cycles a year and up to 95% less water use than open-field agriculture. Produce is sold to Chilean retailers including Cencosud and Walmart Chile, and direct to consumers under the Urban Rabbit brand through a hosted online store. The company has raised roughly USD 12 million, including a USD 4 million Series A led by Kayyak Ventures and a USD 6 million pre-Series B led by ALB Inversiones. AgroUrbana operates its technology internally to run its own farms and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: BMD
providers.description: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) is the national agency responsible for weather forecasting, climate monitoring, and meteorological services in Bangladesh. It provides real-time weather observations, forecasts, warnings, and climate data through its public web portals. The department offers data purchase services, climate data portal, and various online tools for weather information, serving government, researchers, and the public.

providers.name: Brewbird
providers.description: Brewbird provides self‑serve, whole‑bean specialty coffee solutions for offices and hospitality spaces. Their platform lets workplaces offer fresh brewed coffee on demand, using compostable pods filled with beans from top‑tier roasters. Brewbird emphasizes sustainability, zero‑fuss brewing, and a curated selection of local roasters, aiming to replace traditional coffee machines and reduce waste.

providers.name: Brimstone
providers.description: Brimstone is a materials technology company decarbonizing heavy industry through a single-rock co-production process it calls the Rock Refinery. From ordinary calcium silicate rock it extracts multiple high-value materials at once - carbon-negative Portland cement and supplementary cementitious materials, alumina and aluminum, magnesium, titanium, iron/steel feedstock and critical minerals - aiming to use 100% of the feed rock and eliminate tailings while cutting process emissions. The company uses commercially available equipment for a low-cost, market-ready approach, and has secured commitments including Amazon as a buyer of low-carbon cement from its first commercial plant. Brimstone is a private heavy-industry / climate-tech company backed by DCVC and Fifth Wall; it operates no public developer API.

providers.name: Brumby
providers.description: Brumby (formerly GrazeMate) is a Y Combinator-backed (W2026) precision-grazing company based in Sydney, Australia, building an autonomous drone toolkit for cattle ranchers. Brumby drones plan routes and move herds with gentle, AI-guided pressure, fly scheduled monitoring missions that locate and count every animal, measure standing dry-matter pasture biomass from the air, and inspect water troughs, tanks and fences on every flight — all managed from a single phone app that works online or in a local base-station mode without connectivity. The company is running pilot programs and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile is a company lead maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Climavision
providers.description: Climavision is a Louisville, Kentucky weather intelligence company that combines a proprietary nationwide supplemental network of low-altitude X-band, dual-polarization gap-filling weather radars with AI-driven numerical weather prediction (NWP) to deliver enterprise-grade forecasts and observational data. Its Horizon AI product line includes Horizon Point for site-specific forecasts, Horizon Global for ground-to-high- altitude global models, Horizon HI-RES for custom high-resolution local forecasting, and Horizon S2S for subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction. Climavision exposes a Weather API hosted at point-forecast-api.climavision.com with 1,800+ parameters, 15-day forecasts, and bearer-token authentication, plus a separate Radar Status API and Radar-as-a-Service offering that supplies Level II files, NetCDF, and GeoTIFF radar data products (reflectivity, velocity, dual-pol-derived QPE at 1km, precipitation type, tornado debris detection) for coverage below 4,000 feet where NEXRAD cannot see due to Earth curvature. The company integrates its radar feed into MRMS and has provided supplemental data into the National Weather Service's AWIPS software. Climavision processes 1.5+ billion datasets daily, serves customers across agriculture, aviation, commodity trading, drones and Advanced Air Mobility, energy and utilities, government, insurance and reinsurance, media, and transportation and logistics, and raised a $100 million strategic investment from TPG's Rise Fund. API access is gated through a sales-led contact process; no public sandbox or open-source SDKs are published, and the Climavision GitHub organization (github.com/Climavision) currently has only two minor public repositories (an archived Azure Table Storage helper and a GeoServer Helm chart fork).

providers.name: Cyclic Materials
providers.description: Cyclic Materials is a Kingston, Ontario cleantech company founded in 2021 that is building a circular supply chain for rare earth elements and other critical materials. It recovers neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr), samarium, gadolinium, terbium and dysprosium from end-of-life magnet-containing products — electric-vehicle motors, wind-turbine generators, MRI machines and e-waste — using its proprietary MagCycle magnet-separation and REEPure refining processes, and supplies recycled mixed rare earth oxide (rMREO) and recycled copper back into automotive, data-centre, defence and energy manufacturing. The company operates a REEPure commercial demonstration plant and a MagCycle pilot in Kingston, with a Centre of Excellence under construction there and campuses planned in Arizona and South Carolina. It is a materials producer, not a software vendor: it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification, and its only public application surface is an Auth0-gated supplier portal for recyclers, aggregators and core buyers.

providers.name: Ebbcarbon
providers.description: Ebbcarbon is a climate‑tech company that transforms desalination brine into freshwater, permanent carbon removal, and valuable industrial products. By converting waste brine into resources, Ebbcarbon helps desalination operators improve water security, decarbonization, and ocean health, delivering sustainable solutions for industry and the environment.

providers.name: EnerVenue
providers.description: EnerVenue is a Fremont, California-based energy infrastructure company building long-duration stationary energy storage using a metal-hydrogen (nickel-hydrogen) battery chemistry derived from NASA-heritage technology that has powered the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station since the 1980s. Co-founded by Stanford materials scientist Professor Yi Cui, EnerVenue refined the orbital nickel-hydrogen cell into a grid-scale "Energy Storage Vessel" (ESV) targeting a 30-year, 30,000+ cycle service life with 100% usable depth of discharge, ~90% round-trip efficiency, an operating range of -20 C to +60 C, no thermal runaway risk, and no active thermal management. The ESV's aqueous metal cell (AMC) uses a nickel hydroxide cathode, a nickel-alloy anode, an alkaline electrolyte, and hermetically sealed hydrogen gas storage built from steel, nickel, fiberglass, resin, and water — no lithium, cobalt, or rare earths. EnerVenue is scaling manufacturing through a one-million- square-foot gigafactory in Shelby County, Kentucky (1 GWh phase one, scaling toward 20 GWh per year with ~$1B of follow-on investment) plus a high-volume line in Changzhou, China (250 MWh by Q3 2026, 1 GWh in 2027). Customer commitments exceed 7 GWh and include Pine Gate Renewables (2.4 GWh, multi-year), Green Energy Renewable Solutions (Nicon Industries), Sonnell Power Solutions, and VedantaESS. The company closed a $300M Series B in 2026 to fund the gigafactory build-out. EnerVenue sells hardware, EPC-integrated storage systems, and long-duration service warranties — it does not publish a developer API, SDK, public OpenAPI specification, or open-source repository.

providers.name: ENGIE
providers.description: ENGIE is a global energy player headquartered in France, providing electricity, natural gas, and energy services to millions of customers worldwide. The company focuses on sustainable development, renewable energy projects, and digital transformation of its operations. ENGIE’s portfolio includes power generation, distribution, and innovative solutions for energy efficiency, electric mobility, and smart grids, positioning it as a leader in the transition to low‑carbon economies.

providers.name: EnviCore
providers.description: EnviCore is a Calgary, Alberta based sustainability and materials-technology company, backed by Techstars, that produces low-carbon supplementary cementitious materials for the mining and construction industries. Its low-temperature process repurposes industrial waste, mine tailings, clays, and pozzolans into valuable cement replacements, reducing CO2 emissions and supporting a circular economy. EnviCore does not publish a developer API, but its public website exposes an agentic surface: a published llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint for AI-agent access to public site content.

providers.name: Formo
providers.description: Formo (Formo Foods GmbH) is a Berlin-based food-technology company producing animal-free dairy through precision fermentation and microbial fermentation of koji (Aspergillus oryzae). Instead of cows, Formo engineers microorganisms to make milk proteins such as casein, which it turns into real cheese and cream cheese products now sold across Germany and Austria. Founded by Raffael Wohlgensinger and backed by EQT Ventures, the company has received a US FDA "no questions" GRAS letter for its fermentation-derived casein. Formo is a consumer food producer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Hertha Metals
providers.description: Hertha Metals is a hard-technology steel production company based in Conroe, Texas, working to decarbonize and modernize primary steelmaking after centuries of coke-based blast-furnace iron and steel production. Founded by Laureen Meroueh, the company has developed proprietary pyrometallurgical HERS and Flex-HERS technology that produces steel from flexible feedstocks in a single reactor, and has raised roughly $17M toward a commercial steel plant. Hertha Metals is an industrial / climate-tech manufacturer with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company profile.

providers.name: Mitra Chem
providers.description: Mitra Chem is an AI-enabled innovator and manufacturer of battery and critical materials for energy, AI infrastructure and defense applications, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its first commercial product is iron-based lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) cathode active material produced for Western battery cell makers and energy-storage OEMs as a non-China supply source. The company operates The Foundry, an instrumented shared pilot manufacturing facility spanning wet chemistry, hydrometallurgy, particle sizing, drying and heat treatment, and runs an internal full-stack AI platform of physics-based models, digital twins and engineering co-pilots used to compress materials scale-up cost and timelines. The AI platform is internal tooling for Mitra Chem's own manufacturing operations; it is not sold or exposed as a software product, and the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Mosa Meat
providers.description: Mosa Meat is a European food technology company headquartered in Maastricht, the Netherlands, founded in 2016 as a spin-off of Maastricht University by Mark Post and Peter Verstrate. The company develops cultivated (cell-cultured) beef using cellular agriculture: a small cell sample taken from a cow is nurtured through natural processes into muscle and fat tissue, which the company states can yield up to 80,000 burgers from a single sample. Mosa Meat produced the world's first cultured beef hamburger in 2013 and now operates the Mosa C.A.M.P.U.S. (Center for Advanced Meat Production, Upscaling, and Sustainability) in Maastricht, reported as the largest cultivated meat campus in the world. It is a B Corp certified organization pursuing regulatory approval and market entry for cultivated beef burgers. Mosa Meat is a laboratory and food production business; it publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Neocarbon
providers.description: NeoCarbon GmbH is a Berlin-based climate-technology company building integrated cooling and carbon-capture systems for data centers. Its patented Hollow Fiber platform converts low-grade waste heat (30-55C) simultaneously into efficient cooling, captured CO2 for industrial reuse, and recovered water, deployed as a retrofit without redesigning existing infrastructure. Backed by Speedinvest, the company operates as an industrial hardware and climate-infrastructure business and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an API developer portal.

providers.name: Notco
providers.description: NotCo (The Not Company) is a food-technology company founded in 2015 in Santiago, Chile that uses artificial intelligence — its proprietary "Giuseppe" platform — to reverse-engineer animal-based foods from plant ingredients. Its consumer brand at notco.com sells plant-based products including NotMilk, NotMayo, NotBurger and NotIceCream across the Americas, while NotCo AI (notco.ai) licenses the Giuseppe AI R&D platform to global CPG manufacturers such as PepsiCo, Magnum and Barry Callebaut to accelerate food-product innovation. The company is backed by General Catalyst and other investors. NotCo publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its corporate, product, AI-platform and trust/compliance web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pretred
providers.description: Pretred is a Techstars-backed manufacturer of sustainable rubber safety barriers made from recycled waste tires, serving the infrastructure, traffic control, and construction sectors with a circular-economy model. Its product line spans the Standard Rubber Barrier, TL-2 and TL-3 crash-tested barriers, a Load-Rated Barrier rated for heavy machinery, and Paceline bike-lane barriers, each engineered for energy absorption, durability, and modularity. Every Pretred facility can divert over 100 million pounds of waste tires from landfills or incineration annually. As a physical-goods manufacturer, Pretred publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures the company identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: RefineRE
providers.description: RefineRE is a commercial real estate (CRE) SaaS platform that unifies benchmarking, data analysis, and portfolio usage tools into a single product suite for corporate real estate teams. Its eight modules span data foundations, portfolio management, market analysis, ESG tracking, and workplace analytics, helping occupiers and CRE managers optimize their real estate portfolios. A Techstars-backed company, RefineRE is added to the API Evangelist network as a provider profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Sublime Systems
providers.description: Sublime Systems is a Somerville, Massachusetts cement manufacturer spun out of MIT that makes Sublime Cement, a low-carbon replacement for ordinary portland cement. Its ambient-temperature electrochemical "refinery for rocks" process extracts reactive calcium and silicates from low-value rocks and industrial byproducts and blends them into an ASTM-compliant cement that drops into existing concrete mix designs and equipment. The company sells through general-contractor distribution partners and publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: SuperCircle
providers.description: SuperCircle (operated by MASC Inc.) is a technology and reverse-logistics platform that helps retail and fashion brands run circular-economy programs for textiles. It provides turnkey trade-in and resale programs that let consumers send worn clothing back to brands for store credit, manages excess and overstock inventory through a warehouse pickup and logistics network, and delivers real-time performance tracking and customizable impact reporting on recycling and diversion outcomes. Brand partners include Reformation, tentree, Parachute, A.L.C., and Subset. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found at the time of enrichment; this profile is a company lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Whole Surplus
providers.description: Whole Surplus (now operating as Fazla) is a Turkish technology-based waste management and circular-economy company backed by Techstars. It prevents waste at its source and recovers surplus products back into the circular economy with maximum environmental, social, and economic benefit across the entire supply chain from producers to consumers. Its platform combines an AI-powered analysis tool that identifies the optimal recovery path for each product with services including Fazla Market (discounted resale), donations to food banks, animal-feed conversion, recycling, a smart-scale detection system, and sustainability consultancy. Fazla is the first B Corp certified waste-management company in Turkey and is supported by the UN Development Programme (UNDP). The company operates a customer web application (app.fazla.com) but publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Bindingsolutionslimited
providers.description: Binding Solutions Ltd is a fast‑growing technology company focused on decarbonising steel production. It develops green steel technologies, operates a first‑of‑a‑kind plant, and offers process and steel solutions to enable large‑scale low‑carbon steel manufacturing.

providers.name: EVERSTEEL
providers.description: EVERSTEEL is a University of Tokyo-originated startup building AI image-recognition systems that automate the inspection and grading of steel (iron) scrap for steelmakers. Its flagship product, Tetsu-Navi Inspection AI (鉄ナビ検収AI), uses high-resolution cameras and computer-vision models to grade incoming scrap, detect impurities and hazardous materials, and standardize what was previously a manual, expert-dependent process — advancing steel recycling and reducing CO2 emissions from steel production. The company works with major Japanese steel producers including JFE Steel and Kyoei Steel, and is backed by DCM Ventures, Mitsui & Co., Coreline, and the University of Tokyo.

providers.name: RWE Mobility
providers.description: RWE Mobility, part of the RWE Group, provides energy solutions and services across Europe, focusing on renewable energy, electricity generation, and innovative mobility offerings. The company leverages digital platforms to deliver data and APIs for energy management, sustainability reporting, and customer services, supporting a transition to a sustainable energy future.

providers.name: Banyaninfrastructurecorporation
providers.description: Banyaninfrastructurecorporation provides project finance software for infrastructure funds, developers, and green banks. Their platform unifies origination, portfolio management, and compliance reporting, enabling teams to close deals faster, manage risk, and maintain audit‑ready records. The solution replaces fragmented spreadsheets and email threads with a centralized data layer, supporting owners, operators, and financiers in the renewable energy sector.

providers.name: Carnotcompression
providers.description: Carnotcompression (Carnot Compression Inc.) commercializes proprietary isothermal compression technology that delivers low‑temperature, oil‑free compressed air on a 100 % duty cycle. The patented process captures waste heat during compression, reducing energy use and carbon emissions for industrial, commercial and residential applications. The company is based in Scotts Valley, California and is currently beta‑testing models targeting 15‑30 CFM at 100‑150 PSI.

providers.name: Entocycle
providers.description: Entocycle is a London-based insect farming technology company building industrial-scale, controlled-environment facilities that use black soldier fly bioconversion to turn organic waste streams into insect protein for animal feed and organic fertilizer (frass). Its platform combines modular climate-controlled farm infrastructure, real-time AI-driven insect monitoring that counts and tracks insects across their lifecycle, and fully automated production systems to standardize output across deployments worldwide. Entocycle partners with waste management companies, agricultural producers, insect companies, and offtake buyers to develop and operate circular-economy insect farms. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: GECOsistema srl
providers.description: GECOsistema srl is a specialist company that provides advanced engineering cloud‑web, data‑science and modeling studies and services focused on environmental, climate risk and geospatial intelligence. It delivers consulting, monitoring and predictive analytics for public authorities, stakeholders and organisations dealing with environmental modelling, flood risk, air and water pollution, and renewable energy projects.

providers.name: Lowercarbon Capital
providers.description: Lowercarbon Capital is a venture capital firm that backs companies developing technologies to reduce CO₂ emissions, remove carbon from the atmosphere, and extend climate mitigation time. It invests in climate‑tech startups across energy, transportation, industrial materials, and agriculture, providing capital and hands‑on support from idea inception to product launch.

providers.name: Thermondo
providers.description: Thermondo is Germany's largest residential heating installer, focused on heat pumps, photovoltaic (solar) systems, home energy management (thermondo smart), dynamic electricity tariffs, financing and subsidy assistance, and maintenance and repair services for homeowners. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Berlin, the company employs over 1,200 staff and has completed installations for more than 55,000 customers. Thermondo is a consumer-facing climate-energy provider and a portfolio company of HV Capital. It publishes no public developer API or documentation surface; it does operate a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure program and a GitHub organization. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from HV Capital's portfolio and enriched with the public security surface that could be verified.

providers.name: WestfalenWIND
providers.description: WestfalenWIND is a German renewable energy company specializing in wind power generation and related services. It offers electricity tariffs, green energy solutions, and comprehensive information on wind farm planning, operation, and repowering. The website provides detailed sections on photovoltaics, e-mobility, building technology, and green IT, reflecting a broad commitment to sustainable energy and customer-focused offerings across Germany.

providers.name: Aerospace Yuxing
providers.description: Aerospace Yuxing (Chinese: 航天驭星; English brand: Emposat Co., Ltd.; legally Beijing Aerospace Yuxing Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Beijing-headquartered commercial space-infrastructure operator founded in 2016 by a core team drawn from the China Academy of Space Technology and the wider China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation system. It builds and operates the ground segment that commercial satellites depend on: a global network of more than 60 satellite ground stations across China, Kenya, South Africa, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, the South Pacific and South America, plus the Ningxia Zhongwei remote-sensing calibration site. Its service catalog spans launch-vehicle and spacecraft telemetry, tracking and command (TT&C), long-term on-orbit operations management, payload data reception and processing, remote-sensing satellite calibration, space situational awareness and collision warning, debris mitigation, frequency coordination and launch licensing support, and aerospace engineering consulting. It also manufactures ground-system, communication and software-system products - multifunction baseband units, on-board transceivers and transponders, portable and integrated TT&C/data-reception ground stations, and TT&C operations software. The company has served over 370 satellites and rockets, employs roughly 300 people, and closed nearly CNY 2 billion across D, D+ and D++ rounds in 2026. Its customer-facing systems are delivered as installed software and a China-hosted service portal; center-to-center integration is offered over space ground-segment protocols (PDXP, CSP, KISS, CORTEX, AX.25) rather than a public web API. Aerospace Yuxing publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Boruspanprecision
providers.description: Boruspanprecision is a precision engineering subsidiary of Borusan Holding, specializing in high‑accuracy pipe and component manufacturing for industrial and automotive sectors. The company offers advanced machining services, custom‑made precision profiles, and engineering consultancy, leveraging Borusan’s extensive manufacturing network and sustainability initiatives. It serves global clients with a focus on quality, innovation, and environmental responsibility.

providers.name: BrightFarms
providers.description: BrightFarms grows fresh, pesticide‑free greens in indoor farms across the United States, delivering crisp lettuce and salads directly to grocery stores within a day of harvest. The company emphasizes sustainable agriculture, using less water and land while eliminating pesticides, herbicides, and fungicides. Their mission is to create a new generation of farming that benefits the planet and consumers, offering year‑round produce regardless of weather or season.

providers.name: BYD
providers.description: BYD Company Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and publicly listed in Hong Kong (1211) and Shenzhen (002594). Originally a rechargeable-battery maker, BYD has grown into one of the world's largest producers of new-energy vehicles (battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars, buses, and trucks), power batteries (including the Blade Battery), consumer and automotive electronics, rail transit systems (SkyRail/SkyShuttle), forklifts, and solar and energy-storage products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; BYD is a hardware and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: Gbatteries
providers.description: GBatteries (GBatteries Energy Canada Inc.) is an Ottawa, Ontario battery technology company developing lithium-metal battery cells and an intelligent, adaptive battery management system for the next generation of electric mobility, from land to air. Its technology targets fast charging (sub-15-minute charge), high energy density (450+ Wh/kg), extended cycle life, and enhanced safety by actively reducing irreversible internal cell damage. The company reports 60+ granted or pending patents and 9+ years of R&D, and was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company. GBatteries is a hardware and battery-management deeptech firm; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Intergrid
providers.description: Intergrid provides autonomous control solutions for industrial energy systems, enabling operators to optimize energy consumption, integrate renewable sources, and automate grid interactions. Trusted by over 100 sites across Europe, Intergrid’s platform offers real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and seamless integration with existing infrastructure, helping businesses reduce costs and improve sustainability.
